[et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" custom_margin="||80px||false|false" global_colors_info="{}" template_type="row"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_toggle title="AI & Emerging Technology" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Streamline your systems by offloading busy work to AI and automating repetitive processes. Our internal AI experts guide your organization while also offering implementation and project leadership to harness the power of AI for unparalleled innovation.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Cloud & Infrastructure" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Embrace the power of the cloud with our robust solutions for cloud migration, infrastructure optimization, and scalable cloud architecture. Unlock new levels of flexibility, efficiency, and agility.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=" Data Analytics & Integration" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Leverage the full potential of your data with our advanced analytics and integration services. We transform data into actionable insights, fostering data-driven decision-making across your organization.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_toggle title="Agile Project Management" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

We offer Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) so you can enlist the guidance of our skilled leaders on-demand. Whether you need a few extra hands or an entire managing team, our consultants will ensure you get your expected deliverables—at the right time, within the right budget.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Cyber & Identity Security" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Safeguard your digital assets with our robust cybersecurity solutions. From threat detection to identity security, our team works tirelessly to fortify your organization against evolving cyber threats.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Enterprise Applications" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Streamline and enhance your business processes with our expertise in developing and implementing tailored enterprise applications. Including ERP, CRM & Martech, Low-Code Platforms, and 100% custom web and mobile applications, we ensure your applications align with your organizational goals.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row]

We lead your organization through a seamless transition, training your team as they undergo a powerful digital transformation.

We provide ongoing 24/7 support, helping you maintain and improve your systems so that the momentum you’ve built up keeps on accelerating.

Comprehensive consulting services from industry-leading professionals with decades of experience in their domains.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" custom_margin="||80px||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_toggle title="AI & Emerging Technology" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Streamline your systems by offloading busy work to AI and automating repetitive processes. Our internal AI experts guide your organization while also offering implementation and project leadership to harness the power of AI for unparalleled innovation.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Cloud & Infrastructure" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Embrace the power of the cloud with our robust solutions for cloud migration, infrastructure optimization, and scalable cloud architecture. Unlock new levels of flexibility, efficiency, and agility.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=" Data Analytics & Integration" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Leverage the full potential of your data with our advanced analytics and integration services. We transform data into actionable insights, fostering data-driven decision-making across your organization.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_toggle title="Agile Project Management" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

We offer Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) so you can enlist the guidance of our skilled leaders on-demand. Whether you need a few extra hands or an entire managing team, our consultants will ensure you get your expected deliverables—at the right time, within the right budget.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Cyber & Identity Security" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Safeguard your digital assets with our robust cybersecurity solutions. From threat detection to identity security, our team works tirelessly to fortify your organization against evolving cyber threats.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Enterprise Applications" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Streamline and enhance your business processes with our expertise in developing and implementing tailored enterprise applications. Including ERP, CRM & Martech, Low-Code Platforms, and 100% custom web and mobile applications, we ensure your applications align with your organizational goals.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

How M&S Goes the Extra Mile

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="0px||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" header_text_color="#FFFFFF" header_2_font="Source Serif Pro|600|||||||" header_2_text_align="left" header_2_text_color="#FFFFFF" header_2_font_size="36px" header_2_line_height="1.2em" global_colors_info="{}"]

Strengthening Digital Security

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_3,1_3,1_3" use_custom_gutter="on" gutter_width="2" make_equal="on" _builder_version="4.24.2" custom_margin="|||" custom_padding="0px|||||" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Personalized Strategy" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt2-person-pin||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" image_icon_width="71px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" image_icon_custom_margin="||||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||||false|false" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="40px|30px|40px|30px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" hover_enabled="0" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" border_width_all="2px" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="#98C9FA" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22icon_color%22%93}" sticky_enabled="0"]

Our security experts begin by evaluating your business to identify weak points and develop a personalized, cost-effective plan for protecting your data and reducing risk.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Staff Training" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt1-bookmark||fa||400" icon_color="#98C9FA" image_icon_width="72px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="40px|30px|40px|30px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" border_width_all="2px" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="#98C9FA" locked="off" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22header_text_color%22%93}"]

Cyberattacks often exploit human error. That’s why safety-conscious enterprises embed security best practices into every level of their operations. We’re here to help you cultivate a security-first culture by training your team to adopt a cautious, zero-trust mindset.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Ongoing Evolution" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt1-blur-on||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" image_icon_width="72px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="40px|30px|40px|30px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" border_width_all="2px" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" locked="off" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93}"]

As technology evolves, so do the tactics of bad actors. With our help, you can ensure that your organization remains aligned with all of the most advanced strategies for security—staying one step ahead of threats at all times. 

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

Our experts are equipped to use advanced mathematical techniques and tools to analyze your data, delivering powerful predictions that clear away confusion and guide smarter decisions across your entire organization.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Machine Learning (ML)" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt1-filter-tilt-shift||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" image_icon_width="40px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" image_icon_custom_margin="||||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||||false|false" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="0px|0px|0px|0px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="#98C9FA" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22icon_color%22%93}"]

Machine learning is powerful but isn’t magic—in the hands of the inexperienced, it can lead to invalid and misleading results.

Our experienced data scientists are here to make automation work in your favor—we’ll help you use machine learning algorithms effectively so you can more efficiently make sense of your data to solve problems and produce reliable predictions.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row]

Our Approach to PMaaS

Project management addresses a critical need for organizations facing more projects than they have time to complete. Traditional project managers tend to employ methodologies that focus on activities rather than outcomes. 

M&S Consulting’s PMaaS shifts this approach by strategically managing projects to achieve specific objectives. In doing so, we enable greater effectiveness through increased accountability, improved communication, streamlined processes, and deep expertise. Additionally, it provides an independent voice and perspective, further boosting project success.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" width="90%" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" border_color_bottom="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22border_color_bottom%22%93}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/man-woman-laptop-office.jpg" title_text="man-woman-laptop-office" force_fullwidth="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.71em" header_2_font="|600|||||||" header_2_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_2_font_size="48px" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_2_text_color%22%93}"]

How Can PMaaS Benefit Your Organization?

Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) keeps projects on track, taking your business to the next level sooner than your competition. Our team of seasoned experts brings the experience and the know-how to execute even the most complex projects flawlessly.

Ready to level up?
Schedule a call today to talk with one of our experts.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_button button_text="Schedule a Call" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" custom_button="on" button_text_color="#FFFFFF" button_bg_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" button_border_radius="68px" custom_margin="||20px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22button_bg_color%22%93}"][/et_pb_button][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

[et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}" template_type="section"][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="Figtree|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" text_font_size="32px" text_letter_spacing="3px" text_line_height="1.2em" header_font="Figtree|800||on|||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" custom_margin="||19px|||" custom_css_free_form="selector h1 {|| font-weight: 800 !important;||}" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The M&S Advantage

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/getty-images-mjCkN86NZis-unsplash-scaled.jpg" title_text="getty-images-mjCkN86NZis-unsplash" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_heading title="Superior Enterprise Application Support" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" title_font_size="45px" custom_margin="||16px||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_heading][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font||||||||" header_5_font="|--et_global_heading_font_weight|on||||||" header_5_font_size="24px" header_5_line_height="1.5em" custom_margin="||16px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"]
Investing in a robust enterprise application without customizing it to address your unique business needs is like buying a high-end suit but never tailoring it to fit your measurements.
[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" quote_font="--et_global_heading_font|600|||||||" quote_font_size="24px" global_colors_info="{}"]

With our skilled team on your side, your chosen software solutions will truly shine. 

Here’s how we support your enterprise application implementation throughout every step of the process:

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_3,1_3,1_3" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="2px|||||" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.8em" custom_padding="16px||||false|false" border_width_top="4px" border_color_top="gcid-primary-color" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-primary-color%22:%91%22border_color_top%22%93}"]

First, our advisors collaborate with you to develop a strategy, identifying which applications to invest in and how to leverage them to meet your specific challenges and objectives.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.8em" custom_padding="16px||||false|false" border_width_top="4px" border_color_top="gcid-primary-color" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-primary-color%22:%91%22border_color_top%22%93}"]

Next, we guide you through the migration process, ensuring your entire team is fully trained for a seamless transition to these new digital tools.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.8em" custom_padding="16px||||false|false" border_width_top="4px" border_color_top="gcid-primary-color" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-primary-color%22:%91%22border_color_top%22%93}"]

Finally, we seamlessly integrate your tailored or custom-built applications into your operations, offering ongoing support to continually optimize your investment.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

Software Security Control Implementation

To comply with increasingly stringent regulations, organizations must apply complex security controls at every level of their software systems. From deploying a comprehensive security system to strengthening your data loss prevention strategies to securing and encrypting data, we're poised and ready to improve your security posture.

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Identity Management" admin_label="Identity Management" tab_media="none" font_icon="||divi||400" font_icon_active="||divi||400" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|500|||||||" header_font="--et_global_heading_font||||||||" header_2_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|500|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Identity Management

Modern organizations need to manage user identities across a diverse range of applications and populations. To streamline this process, we design and implement advanced identity solutions tailored to the unique needs of your organization. Allow us to increase the efficiency of your identity practices while mitigating security risks.

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Access Management" admin_label="Access Management" tab_media="none" font_icon="||fa||400" font_icon_active="||fa||400" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|500|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Who should have access to what, and for how long?

Your organization faces threats from all angles in today's zero-trust world—and simple authentication methods are no longer sufficient. [/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="DevSecOps" admin_label="DevSecOps" tab_media="none" font_icon="||divi||400" font_icon_active="||divi||400" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|--et_global_body_font_weight|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

DevSecOps

Short for Development, Security, and Operations, DevSecOps is a framework we employ here at M&S. It means that we integrate security testing into every single step of the software development process, catching vulnerabilities early and fixing them before they become problematic.

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Containerization" admin_label="Containerization" tab_media="none" font_icon="||fa||900" font_icon_active="||fa||900" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|--et_global_body_font_weight|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Containerization

Containerization isolates applications by bundling a workload’s code with everything it needs to run on any infrastructure. This not only boosts security but also makes coding and deployment more efficient, ensuring your other applications remain secure even if one is compromised.

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Security for AI" admin_label="Security for AI" tab_media="none" font_icon="||fa||900" font_icon_active="||fa||900" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|--et_global_body_font_weight|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="gcid-primary-color" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-primary-color%22:%91%22button_bg_color%22%93}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Security for AI

Is your business excited by the possibilities of AI but intimidated by its uncertainties?

Our team helps you leverage AI responsibly—ensuring compliance, protecting private data, and preserving customer trust by addressing the unique risks posed by AI.

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Security for APIs" admin_label="Security for APIs" tab_media="none" font_icon="||fa||900" font_icon_active="||fa||900" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|--et_global_body_font_weight|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Security for APIs

Application Programming Interfaces act as middlemen, helping two applications communicate with one another. APIs are connected to sensitive data—and that means they’re a prime target for attacks. We’re here to help you identify and resolve any vulnerabilities before they put you at risk.

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][/dipi_advanced_tabs][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

item.content:encoded:
[et_pb_section fb_built="1" admin_label="Our Services" _builder_version="4.24.2" background_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}" template_type="section"][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" use_custom_gutter="on" gutter_width="2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="0px||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_text_color="#FFFFFF" header_2_font="Source Serif Pro|700|||||||" header_2_text_align="left" header_2_text_color="#FFFFFF" header_2_font_size="48px" header_2_line_height="1.2em" custom_margin="||0px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"]

How We Guide Your Data Transformation

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/man-woman-laptop-office.jpg" title_text="man-woman-laptop-office" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="50px||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Personalized Strategy" image_icon_width="71px" _builder_version="4.24.2" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="40px|30px|40px|30px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" border_width_all="2px" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22icon_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22%93}"]

We start by understanding the present state of your data strategy as well as the challenges you’re facing and your objectives for the future.

Then, with a focus on precision and practicality, we create and implement a roadmap for transforming your business into a data-driven enterprise.

From developing systems that continuously collect diverse sources of data, to securely storing and managing that data, to providing you with clear analytical reports that inform smarter decision-making, we’re here to make data your business’s greatest asset.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" use_custom_gutter="on" gutter_width="2" make_equal="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" custom_margin="|||" custom_padding="0px|||||" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Staff Mentoring and Expert Advising" image_icon_width="71px" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="40px|30px|40px|30px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" border_width_all="2px" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" locked="off" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22icon_color%22,%22icon_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22header_text_color%22%93}"]

If data hasn’t been a priority for your organization in the past or you’ve been relying mainly on traditional but outdated business intelligence tools, don’t worry—we’re here to simplify your modernization journey.

We’ll help you adopt and master advanced data tools while also nurturing a company culture that embraces interconnected data sharing and informed decision-making.

Let our team guide your enterprise through the transition from old to new, empowering you to harness the power of emerging technologies like artificial intelligence, the Internet of Things, and more.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Integration of Evolving Data Technologies" image_icon_width="71px" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="40px|30px|40px|30px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" border_width_all="2px" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" locked="off" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22icon_color%22,%22icon_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22header_text_color%22%93}"]

Every day, new and innovative tools emerge to help organizations unlock the full potential of their data. That’s why the smartest data strategy is one that’s constantly evolving.

When you partner with our consultants, you gain access to decades of data expertise.

We’re here to help you navigate complex databases and analytical tools, advise you on which digital solutions will bring your organization the highest ROI, and seamlessly integrate cutting-edge technologies into your existing data environment.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

item.content:encoded:
[et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}" template_type="section"][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_2_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_2_font_size="48px" header_4_font="--et_global_body_font|800|||||||" header_4_text_color="gcid-primary-color" header_4_letter_spacing="4px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_2_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-primary-color%22:%91%22header_4_text_color%22%93}"]

THE M&S ADVANTAGE

What Makes Us a Superior Cloud Partner

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_width_bottom="2px" border_color_bottom="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22border_color_bottom%22%93}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/cloud-experts.png" title_text="cloud-experts" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" box_shadow_style="preset3" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="22px" text_line_height="1.6em" module_alignment="left" custom_margin="0px||50px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"]

IaaS & PaaS

We specialize in the two key components of cloud computing: Infrastructure as a Service and Platform as a Service. Instead of working with a separate consulting team for each need, you can leverage our comprehensive expertise. 

Cloud Infrastructure empowers you to leave behind outdated legacy systems and switch to on-demand serverless data storage and management. As a consulting collective with a rich history, we’re experts of both the old and the new—meaning we can help you bridge the gap between the two seamlessly. 

Cloud Platforms provide the essential hardware and software businesses need to develop powerful applications. Our team will handle the heavy lifting to help you adopt and utilize these solutions so you can focus more of your energy on fueling innovation.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" custom_margin="40px||||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" border_color_bottom="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22border_color_bottom%22%93}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/multi-cloud-solutions.jpg" title_text="multi-cloud-solutions" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" box_shadow_style="preset3" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_text_color="rgba(255,255,255,0.9)" text_font_size="22px" text_line_height="1.6em" header_5_text_color="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" header_5_font_size="24px" header_5_line_height="1.5em" module_alignment="left" custom_margin="50px||50px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89%22:%91%22header_5_text_color%22%93}"]
"A consulting team that can only help you utilize a single cloud provider is like a mechanic who only knows how to use one tool. Or a DJ who only plays one artist."
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="22px" text_line_height="1.6em" module_alignment="left" custom_margin="0px||50px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"]

Multi-Cloud Solutions

Want to mix and match different capabilities from a diverse array of cloud vendors? We’ll help you tailor a multi-cloud environment that meets the exact needs of your organization. We have extensive experience working with Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Salesforce, and more. 

This rare depth of knowledge enables us to provide valuable insights and guidance on the most effective ways to leverage each cloud platform, considering its unique strengths and limitations.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

[et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" background_color="#FFFFFF" global_colors_info="{}" template_type="section"][et_pb_row column_structure="3_4,1_4" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="3_4" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" text_font="||on||||||" text_font_size="24px" text_line_height="1.6em" header_3_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_3_line_height="1.3em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_3_text_color%22%93}"]

M&S Consulting Oracle Software Services

Whether you’re starting from scratch or fixing up an Oracle implementation that isn’t optimized, our M&S team is here to help you set up and sustain your Oracle systems for long-term success.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_4" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_3,1_3,1_3" use_custom_gutter="on" gutter_width="2" make_equal="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" custom_padding="0px||||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_3" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Strategy and Planning" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt1-assignment-turned-in||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" image_icon_width="40px" icon_alignment="left" admin_label="Strategy and Planning" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-heading-color" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" image_icon_custom_margin="||||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||||false|false" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="0px|0px|0px|0px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="#98C9FA" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22border_color_all%22%93,%22gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-heading-color%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

Our Oracle experts are dedicated to helping clients understand their options, develop a roadmap for success, and meticulously execute a high-performing Oracle vision.

Our Approach to PMaaS

Project management addresses a critical need for organizations facing more projects than they have time to complete. Traditional project managers tend to employ methodologies that focus on activities rather than outcomes. 

M&S Consulting’s PMaaS shifts this approach by strategically managing projects to achieve specific objectives. In doing so, we enable greater effectiveness through increased accountability, improved communication, streamlined processes, and deep expertise. Additionally, it provides an independent voice and perspective, further boosting project success.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" width="90%" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" border_color_bottom="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22border_color_bottom%22%93}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/man-woman-laptop-office.jpg" title_text="man-woman-laptop-office" force_fullwidth="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.71em" header_2_font="|600|||||||" header_2_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_2_font_size="48px" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_2_text_color%22%93}"]

How Can PMaaS Benefit Your Organization?

Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) keeps projects on track, taking your business to the next level sooner than your competition. Our team of seasoned experts brings the experience and the know-how to execute even the most complex projects flawlessly.

Ready to level up?
Schedule a call today to talk with one of our experts.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_button button_text="Schedule a Call" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" custom_button="on" button_text_color="#FFFFFF" button_bg_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" button_border_radius="68px" custom_margin="||20px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22button_bg_color%22%93}"][/et_pb_button][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

Need a completely original application built from the ground up for your business? We’ve got you covered. Whether it’s a customer-facing app for your brand, a tool to enhance your team’s productivity or anything else you can envision, our expert developers are here to bring your vision to life.

Mobile apps are a powerful way to serve your employees or customers straight from the convenience of their smartphone or tablet.

We create high-performing, personalized mobile apps with user-friendly interfaces. 

Key advantages of mobile apps include: 

  • Integration with device features like GPS, camera, and microphone
  • Engaging visual and audio content
  • Real-time updates
  • Convenient for consistent daily use
  • Offline usability for uninterrupted access

A well-crafted web app is an opportunity to engage your audience with interactive content that goes beyond static pages. 

We design responsive web apps that adapt to any device, ensuring an optimal user experience across all screens.

Key advantages of web apps include:

  • Faster deployment, updates, and maintenance
  • No need for users to download an app
  • Direct access from the browser
  • Easier user acquisition and traffic generation
  • Broader reach and audience

We harness the power of AI and ML to build intelligent systems that drive business evolution. 

Artificial Intelligence systems demonstrate behaviors of human intelligence—like learning, reasoning, and problem solving. 

Machine Learning is a subset of AI—the study of algorithms that allow machines to learn through experience. 

We leverage AI and ML to make accurate predictions about the future, demystify complex trends, optimize business operations, develop cutting-edge apps, and more.

Learn more about our Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning services.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Video Games (with Augmented & Virtual Reality)" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt2-games||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" image_icon_width="40px" icon_alignment="left" admin_label="Video Games (with Augmented & Virtual Reality)" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" image_icon_custom_margin="||||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||||false|false" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="0px|0px|0px|0px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="#98C9FA" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22icon_color%22%93}"]

Our industry-leading developers use gaming technology to bridge the physical and digital worlds, creating powerful new ways for people to interact with content. 

Video Games are an incredible tool for engaging, entertaining, and educating users.

Augmented Reality (AR) adds digital elements to a live perspective, often by using the camera on a smartphone. AR can drastically expand the way our devices assist us with daily tasks by seamlessly blending digital content with the real world.

Virtual Reality (VR) is a complete immersion technology that empowers users to experience a variety of real-world and simulated environments. VR can take people anywhere, helping users learn about different places and ideas by experiencing them virtually.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" use_custom_gutter="on" gutter_width="2" make_equal="on" _builder_version="4.24.2" custom_margin="|||" custom_padding="0px|||||" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Platforms" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt2-pages||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" image_icon_width="40px" icon_alignment="left" admin_label="Platforms" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" image_icon_custom_margin="||||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||||false|false" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="0px|0px|0px|0px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="#98C9FA" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22icon_color%22%93}"]

Managing complex interactions between multiple parties is only possible through the use of a robust platform. 

Our experts design sleek, scalable platforms that give you on-demand access to an interconnected network of resources and users.

Our well-built platforms will serve your business in four key ways:

  • Building and engaging a user base
  • Connecting different user types (like buyers and sellers)
  • Facilitating exchanges of goods, services, or information
  • Standardizing interactions for a consistent user experience
[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.16" custom_padding="|||" global_colors_info="{}" custom_padding__hover="|||"][et_pb_blurb title="Firmware" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-smt1-developer-board||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" image_icon_width="40px" icon_alignment="left" admin_label="Firmware" _builder_version="4.27.4" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="32px" header_line_height="1.2em" body_font="||||||||" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" body_line_height="1.8em" background_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" image_icon_custom_margin="||||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||||false|false" background_layout="dark" height="100%" custom_padding="0px|0px|0px|0px|true|true" animation_style="fold" animation="off" header_font_size_tablet="32px" header_font_size_phone="29px" header_font_size_last_edited="on|phone" border_color_all="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="#98C9FA" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_all%22,%22icon_color%22%93}"]

If you’re building an innovative device, firmware is just as important as your hardware design. 

Firmware is a software program that provides low-level control for your device’s hardware—either by providing a standard environment for more complex software or by acting as the complete operating system for simpler devices.

Our developers specialize in creating elegant firmware solutions that work seamlessly with your hardware and handle essential functions like monitoring and data manipulation.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

Salesforce Backup and Enterprise Analytics

Enterprise clients need more from their Salesforce reporting environment. We’ve built a custom platform to address this. Nero allows you to combine with non-Salesforce data in the same high-performance, customized environment.

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Experience Cloud" admin_label="Identity Management" tab_media="none" font_icon="||divi||400" font_icon_active="||divi||400" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|500|||||||" header_font="--et_global_heading_font||||||||" header_2_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|500|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Enhancing Connection & Collaboration Through Custom Portals

 

We build Self-Service Portals, Customer Portals, and Partner Portals in the Salesforce Experience Cloud that enhance our customers’ collaboration. ​​The robust solutions possible in the Experience Cloud enable organizations to expand their scope of community engagement, collaboration with partners, and employee connection through branded experience clouds. From personalized content to core integrations, Experience Cloud is a powerful asset to many businesses when you understand how to best optimize it.

Curious what Experience Cloud solutions could look like in your business? Let’s start a conversation. 

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Marketing Cloud" admin_label="Access Management" tab_media="none" font_icon="||fa||400" font_icon_active="||fa||400" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|500|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Personalized Customer Engagement & Analytics At-Scale

 

The Salesforce Marketing Cloud is a powerful tool to help your company plan, manage, track, and optimize your marketing strategy. When optimized correctly, you’re able to connect your customers’ data across channels, engage across the entire customer journey, utilize AI for actionable insights, personalize your marketing to each customer, and much more. Our certified team of experts have niche expertise in high-ROI Salesforce processes and technology solutions.

Let’s take your company’s marketing capabilities to the next level. Schedule a call today. [link]

[/dipi_advanced_tabs_item][dipi_advanced_tabs_item title="Sales Cloud" admin_label="DevSecOps" tab_media="none" font_icon="||divi||400" font_icon_active="||divi||400" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="--et_global_body_font|--et_global_body_font_weight|||||||" header_3_font="--et_global_heading_font|--et_global_heading_font_weight|||||||" custom_button="on" button_text_size="14px" button_bg_color="#440099" button_border_width="0px" button_border_color="#440099" button_border_radius="0px" button_font="Montserrat||||||||" button_use_icon="on" button_icon="$||divi||400" button_on_hover="off" button_alignment="left" button_custom_margin="30px||||false|false" button_custom_padding="10px|35px|10px|20px|false|false" box_shadow_style_button="preset3" global_colors_info="{}" button_bg_color__hover="rgba(68,0,153,0.8)" button_bg_color__hover_enabled="on|hover" button_border_color__hover="#440099" button_border_color__hover_enabled="on|desktop"]

Sales Cloud Solutions Since 2002

One platform. Efficient and organized data. Built-in trusted AI. Our team has been working with the Salesforce Sales Cloud since 2002, when Salesforce was still a small business. Today, the Sales Cloud provides exceptional tools to automate and optimize all of your sales processes—through the entire sales lifecycle. Our team has years of experience developing and implementing custom Sales Cloud Solutions that help our customers drive business every day. 

Don’t settle for inefficiency in your sales process. Let’s start a conversation.

Our team specializes in managing all different sorts and sizes of data. 

Let us handle the heavy lifting of consolidating all your separate data sources into one organized, central spot. 

We can also help you incorporate cost-saving open-source tools like Hadoop into your data warehouse environment so you don’t have to spend a fortune on traditional database systems.

Although they’re powerful repository tools, data lakes can quickly become swamps if not correctly designed and managed. 

We’ll lead you through a dependable data lake design and implementation using simple but powerful techniques like landing zones, cataloging, data lineage, and unstructured data pre-processing.

It’s time to dive deeper than the surface-level row, and column sums most applications provide.

We’re here to streamline your data storage practices and deepen your insights using advanced platforms like Snowflake, Oracle, Microsoft, and Amazon.

Discover actionable metrics that enable your decision-makers to follow the guide of facts and sound analysis—not guesses and gut instinct.

Our experts implement intelligent systems that help your data flow smoothly across your entire enterprise—from loading and processing to sharing between departments. 

As a result, your entire workforce enjoys easy access to up-to-date information, ensuring all your employees stay on the same page. 

We help your organization stay connected so your teams can exchange key insights and make smarter decisions at every level.

It’s our job to make yours easier. That’s why we do so much more than just crunching the numbers.

It’s never been easier for you and your entire team to understand key data analytics at a glance.

Streamline your systems by offloading busy work to AI and automating repetitive processes. Our internal AI experts guide your organization while also offering implementation and project leadership to harness the power of AI for unparalleled innovation.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Cloud & Infrastructure" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Embrace the power of the cloud with our robust solutions for cloud migration, infrastructure optimization, and scalable cloud architecture. Unlock new levels of flexibility, efficiency, and agility.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title=" Data Analytics & Integration" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Leverage the full potential of your data with our advanced analytics and integration services. We transform data into actionable insights, fostering data-driven decision-making across your organization.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_toggle title="Agile Project Management" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

We offer Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) so you can enlist the guidance of our skilled leaders on-demand. Whether you need a few extra hands or an entire managing team, our consultants will ensure you get your expected deliverables—at the right time, within the right budget.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Cyber & Identity Security" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Safeguard your digital assets with our robust cybersecurity solutions. From threat detection to identity security, our team works tirelessly to fortify your organization against evolving cyber threats.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Enterprise Applications" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Streamline and enhance your business processes with our expertise in developing and implementing tailored enterprise applications. Including ERP, CRM & Martech, Low-Code Platforms, and 100% custom web and mobile applications, we ensure your applications align with your organizational goals.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

[et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}" template_type="section"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

the solution

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Breathing Room" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-fas fa-book-reader||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" image_icon_custom_margin="||0px||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||5px||false|false" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22icon_color%22%93,%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89%22:%91%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93}"]

We reviewed and renegotiated key contracts. We stabilized every system that was in flux. We created breathing room for the organization while helping the executive team make thoughtful, long-term decisions.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Budgeting" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-fas fa-money-bill||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" image_icon_custom_margin="||0px||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||5px||false|false" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22icon_color%22%93,%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89%22:%91%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93}"]

One of the biggest needs was clarity during budget season (a process that had been a source of frustration for years). So we built a budgeting app that brought visibility, accountability, and ease to the process. It wasn’t just a tool. It was a new way of operating. People embraced it, and it remained in use long after our engagement ended.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="The Search" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-fas fa-search||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" image_icon_custom_margin="||0px||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||5px||false|false" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22icon_color%22%93,%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89%22:%91%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93}"]

Alongside this work, we helped lead the executive search for the new CIO. We advised on the job scope, led interviews, and made recommendations. Throughout it all, we remained active in day-to-day operations, ensuring stability while paving the way for the future.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="A Multidisciplinary Response" use_icon="on" font_icon="agsdix-far fa-handshake||fa||400" icon_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" image_icon_custom_margin="||0px||false|false" image_icon_custom_padding="||5px||false|false" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_text_color%22,%22icon_color%22%93,%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22body_text_color%22,%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89%22:%91%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93,%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93}"]

And we didn’t do it alone. M&S brought in specialists from across our team. Others stepped in for technical assessments and systems support. It was a multidisciplinary response that delivered far more than one person ever could. That’s what made it work.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

Higher Education

Navigating the ever-changing nature of IT and its value to the institution.

[/cs_text][/cs_column][cs_column fade="false" fade_animation="in" fade_animation_offset="45px" fade_duration="750" _label="1/4" type="1/4" style="padding: 0px;"] [/cs_column][/cs_row][/cs_section][cs_section parallax="false" separator_top_type="none" separator_top_height="50px" separator_top_inset="0px" separator_top_angle_point="50" separator_bottom_type="none" separator_bottom_height="50px" separator_bottom_inset="0px" separator_bottom_angle_point="50" _label="Overview" style="margin: 0px;padding: 60px 0px;"][cs_row inner_container="true" marginless_columns="false" _label="Row 1" style="margin: 0px auto;padding: 0px;"][cs_column fade="false" fade_animation="in" fade_animation_offset="45px" fade_duration="750" _label="1/3" type="1/2" style="padding: 0px;"][cs_text]
At a key juncture where many institutions are targeting more diverse populations of students while dealing with smaller budgets, our innovation and creativity coupled with core technology expertise bring unique and cost-effective solutions to campus.
[/cs_text][/cs_column][cs_column fade="false" fade_animation="in" fade_animation_offset="45px" fade_duration="750" _label="1/3" type="1/2" style="padding: 0px;"][x_blockquote cite="<em>Project Manager, Higher Education Institution</em>" type="left" style="margin-top:0em;"]You all came in here with the technical knowledge we needed, but I’m amazed at how quickly you understood and improved our business processes as well.[/x_blockquote][/cs_column][/cs_row][cs_row inner_container="true" marginless_columns="false" _label="New Item 2" style="margin: 40px auto 0px;padding: 20px 0px 0px;"][cs_column fade="false" fade_animation="in" fade_animation_offset="45px" fade_duration="750" type="2/3" style="padding: 0px;"][cs_text]At M&S Consulting, we understand the ever-changing nature of IT and its value to the institution. Our experts bring over 20 years of Higher Education experience leading the development and implementation of university enterprise systems including Oracle eBusiness Suite, PeopleSoft, Ellucian Banner, and Blackboard Learning Management systems. In addition to ERP implementation, enhancement, and operational management, we bring a deep experience in core technologies to any Higher Education environment such as Fusion Middleware (SOA and Identity/Access Management, Business Intelligence, and Data Analytics).[/cs_text][/cs_column][cs_column fade="false" fade_animation="in" fade_animation_offset="45px" fade_duration="750" type="1/3"
