That was a near impossible task to get right the first time, but you did.[/x_blockquote][/cs_column][/cs_row][/cs_section][cs_element_section _id="75" ][cs_element_row _id="76" ][cs_element_column _id="77" ][cs_element_headline _id="78" ][x_recent_posts type="post" count="4" offset="" category="higher-education" orientation="horizontal" no_sticky="true" no_image="false" fade="false"][/cs_element_column][/cs_element_row][/cs_element_section][/cs_content][cs_content_seo] Higher Education Navigating the ever-changing nature of IT and its value to the institution.  At a key juncture where many institutions are targeting more diverse populations of students while dealing with smaller budgets, our innovation and creativity coupled with core technology expertise bring unique and cost-effective solutions to campus. You all came in here with the technical knowledge we needed, but I’m amazed at how quickly you understood and improved our business processes as well.Project Manager, Higher Education InstitutionAt M&S Consulting, we understand the ever-changing nature of IT and its value to the institution. Our experts bring over 20 years of Higher Education experience leading the development and implementation of university enterprise systems including Oracle eBusiness Suite, PeopleSoft, Ellucian Banner, and Blackboard Learning Management systems. In addition to ERP implementation, enhancement, and operational management, we bring a deep experience in core technologies to any Higher Education environment such as Fusion Middleware (SOA and Identity/Access Management, Business Intelligence, and Data Analytics). A Sampling of Our Higher Education Clients #wpls-logo-showcase-slider-1 .wp-post-image, #wpls-logo-showcase-slider-1 .wp-post-image img.wp-post-image{max-height:250px; } Survey Results for “COVID-19 Impacts on Higher Education” Our survey results compile faculty responses on diverse issues related to higher education experience in the COVID-19 pandemic. While speaking to the challenges and frustrations of the abrupt transition to online delivery in Spring 2020, respondents also had many ideas about how they and their institutions could strengthen their students’ educational outcomes. Our analysis of this data considers the challenges and critiques offered by our respondents but focuses on the constructive suggestions participants offered on how to move forward in a situation that continues to present many challenges. Get the Results Strategic Procure-to-Pay Assessment Shrinking budgets and increasing operating costs are placing higher education procurement departments under increased pressure to both engage campus users as organizational partners and serve the institution as purchasing knowledge experts. In addition, procurement departments continue to be responsible for ensuring appropriate controls and compliance as well as enabling increased buying power across campus. Download the free PDF Implementing and Integrating These Great Technologies and More Application Solutions and Integration M&S Consulting’s team of enterprise architects and developers can provide seamless integration for many campus systems. Utilizing best practices and comprehensive middleware integration tools, we can integrate throughout the campus and into the cloud. At West Virginia University, our team lead the effort to design & develop SOA based integrations of Payment and Vendor data to and from the State ERP system using a robust and advanced queuing and debatching concept for high volume batch interfaces. In addition, we utilized this same infrastructure to integrate Oracle eBusiness Suite HCM with cloud hosted Oracle Taleo recruiting portal while also designing and developing an Ellucian Banner to The Common Application integration. Infrastructure and the Cloud Moving to the cloud for any institution can be complicated and overwhelming. M&S Consulting brings the expertise and partnerships necessary to take even the most complex systems to the cloud, saving the institution on personnel and data center expenses. At Harvard University Business Publishing, M&S drove the project to migrate their 150+ servers, including the ERP application, Oracle eBusiness Suite, to the Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud, thus allowing for the closure of their on-premises data center. In this classic “lift and shift” approach, the emphasis was first to move the servers to the cloud, providing immediate benefit to the institution. Subsequent phases will work within each application to begin taking advantage of many AWS platform services. Security and Risk With cyber attacks on the rise for higher education, M&S can help institutions reduce these risks through our expert knowledge of best practices in identity and access management (including two-factor authentication), enterprise architecture (including high availability, disaster recovery, and hardening to address third-party security assessment findings), HIPAA, FERPA, and PCIDSS. I'm very impressed by your work ethic and attention to detail. Our survey results compile faculty responses on diverse issues related to higher education experience in the COVID-19 pandemic. While speaking to the challenges and frustrations of the abrupt transition to online delivery in Spring 2020, respondents also had many ideas about how they and their institutions could strengthen their students\u2019 educational outcomes.

\n

Our analysis of this data considers the challenges and critiques offered by our respondents but focuses on the constructive suggestions participants offered on how to move forward in a situation that continues to present many challenges.

item.title: Detailed Ticket History (Lite) Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: brandon.jones
item.content:encoded:
Data Security and Privacy Statement

Overview

This is a data security and privacy statement for the Issue History Analytics app.

App Architecture

This application operates exclusively on the client side. All required raw data is fetched using Atlassian APIs on your client (browser) and then processed to be displayed without sending it to any servers on the same client (browser). Any settings and configuration required for the app to work are saved within your Jira instance.

Privacy

We do not collect any personal data from your use of our application. Usage statistics and licensing information are collected through Atlassian's marketplace API.

Data collected from your use of our Server/Data Center Apps

No data is collected and/or sent to any servers. Your data does not leave your own servers under any circumstances.

Cloud Apps

Permissions Scope

Our plugin requires read permission to be able to read your issues, issue details, and issue changelogs.

Data Storage/Data Retention

No personally identifiable data is stored on our servers, as the application runs exclusively on the client-side. All configuration is stored in Atlassian servers.

Security

All application components and code is served to you from our servers, using SSL. If you have found a security vulnerability, please email us at atlassian.applications@mandsconsulting.com immediately.

Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our app or through other communication methods.

Contact Us

If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at atlassian.applications@mandsconsulting.com.

End-User License Agreement (EULA) for M&S Consulting Atlassian Apps

This End-User License Agreement ("EULA") is a legally binding agreement between you and M&S Consulting. This EULA agreement governs your acquisition and use of our third-party Atlassian apps ("software") directly from M&S Consulting or indirectly through an authorized reseller or distributor of M&S Consulting (a "Reseller"). Please read this EULA agreement carefully before completing the installation process and using our software. It provides a license to use our software and contains warranty information and liability disclaimers. If you register for a free trial of our software, this EULA agreement will also govern that trial. By installing and/or using our software, you are confirming your acceptance of the software and agreeing to become bound by the terms of this EULA agreement. If you are entering into this EULA agreement on behalf of a company or other legal entity, you represent that you have the authority to bind such entity and its affiliates to these terms and conditions. If you do not have such authority or if you do not agree with the terms and conditions of this EULA agreement, do not install or use our software, and you must not accept this EULA agreement. This EULA agreement shall apply only to software supplied by M&S Consulting herewith, regardless of whether other software is referred to or described herein. The terms also apply to any M&S Consulting updates, supplements, Internet-based services, and support services for our software, unless other terms accompany those items on delivery. If so, those terms apply.

License Grant

M&S Consulting hereby grants you a personal, non-transferable, non-exclusive license to use our software on your devices in accordance with the terms of this EULA agreement. You are permitted to load our software (for example, on a PC, laptop, mobile, or tablet) under your control. You are responsible for ensuring your device meets the minimum requirements of the software. You are not permitted to:
  • Edit, alter, modify, adapt, or otherwise change the whole or any part of our software, nor decompile, disassemble or reverse engineer our software or attempt to do any such things.
  • Reproduce, copy, distribute, or resell our software.
  • Use our software in any way that breaches any applicable local, national, or international law.
  • Use our software for any purpose that M&S Consulting considers a breach of this EULA agreement.

Intellectual Property and Ownership

M&S Consulting shall retain ownership of the software as originally downloaded by you and all subsequent downloads of our software by you. The software (including copyright and other intellectual property rights of whatever nature in our software, including any modifications made thereto) are and shall remain the property of M&S Consulting. M&S Consulting reserves the right to grant licenses to use the software to third parties.

Termination

This EULA agreement is effective from the date you first use our software and shall continue until terminated. You may terminate it at any time upon written notice to M&S Consulting. It will also terminate immediately if you fail to comply with any term of this EULA agreement. Upon such termination, the licenses granted by this EULA agreement will immediately terminate, and you agree to stop all access and use of our software. Provisions that, by their nature, continue and survive will survive any termination of this EULA agreement.

Governing Law

This EULA agreement, and any dispute arising out of or in connection with this EULA agreement, shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the United States.

Since 2002, M&S Consulting has been a trusted partner for both commercial and public sector clients, specializing in digital strategy and transformation for critical business functions.

Our team of over 250 consultants has carved a niche in the industry by seamlessly integrating process and technology. With our depth and breadth of services, we offer decades of experience in identifying, scaling, mobilizing, implementing, and maintaining digital transformation initiatives regardless of where you are on the journey.

Not Your Average Internship

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" custom_padding="12px|||||" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" text_font="Source Serif Pro||||||||" text_font_size="24px" text_line_height="1.6em" header_3_font="|600|||||||" header_3_text_color="gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-d33ceeb9-792b-4295-a343-673d69c1ef89%22:%91%22header_3_text_color%22%93}"]

"The experience I’ve gained at M&S is far and above more valuable than my experiences at other organizations. I’m given important tasks and am continually learning in ways that benefit me now and down the road. That, combined with a positive, hardworking culture of the best consultants in the field, results in one of the most fertile grounds for young professionals. If you want to do great work and be rewarded for it, come to M&S."

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" text_line_height="1.8em" global_colors_info="{}"]

Your college education is a good foundation to begin your real learning. We allow you to get your hands dirty from day one. You’ll enjoy an environment where you’re challenged to find solutions and encouraged to ask questions. Surrounding yourself with friendly and helpful professionals who are experts in their field will grow and motivate you. We want to pour our knowledge and understanding into you, but we expect you’ll pour your passion and excitement back into our organization and the projects you’re working on. You’re treated as a valued asset, because you are.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

Artificial Intelligence (AI)

is more than just a buzzword. It’s a transformative tool that’s rippling across every industry – changing the way people work and do business at a fundamental level.

For 20 years, M&S Consulting has been harnessing the power of AI to give businesses the strategic competitive advantage that propels them into the future. Our seasoned team of AI professionals is here to safely and efficiently integrate strategies for businesses looking to leverage AI and Machine Learning Capabilities.

Unlocking the Power of Agentic AI for Your Organization

AI is evolving beyond simple automation—Agentic AI introduces a new paradigm where AI systems autonomously plan, execute, and adapt tasks to achieve business goals with minimal human intervention. These AI agents don’t just follow pre-set rules; they dynamically assess objectives, resources, and constraints, then devise and iterate solutions in real time, even changing course when things get off track.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.71em" header_2_font="|600|||||||" header_2_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_2_font_size="48px" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_2_text_color%22%93}"]

AI systems can now function as collaborative agents—one generating content while another validates compliance or quality. Agent interactions are orchestrated through centralized platforms such as AgentForce—leading to enhanced productivity across inter-departmental and multi-party business functions.

At M&S Consulting, we help organizations harness Agentic AI to unlock greater efficiency, scalability, and strategic intelligence. Whether it's integrating AI-driven decision-making into enterprise systems, developing smart human-machine workflow automation, or ensuring governance over autonomous AI processes, we provide the expertise to make Agentic AI work for you.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="3_5,2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_heading title="How Can Agentic AI Transform Your Business?" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_heading][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" custom_margin="||80px||false|false" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_toggle title="Automated Decision-Making & Execution" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

AI agents can assess complex data inputs, generate insights, and autonomously take action—streamlining decision-making while reducing human workload.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Enterprise AI Integration" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

Our solutions connect Agentic AI with your existing systems, from Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle to proprietary applications—ensuring a seamless and secure AI-driven workflow.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_toggle title="AI-Driven Business Optimization" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

From predictive analytics to intelligent process automation, AI agents optimize workflows by dynamically adjusting to changing business needs.

[/et_pb_toggle][et_pb_toggle title="Secure and Ethical AI Governance" open_toggle_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" title_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22title_text_color%22,%22open_toggle_text_color%22%93}"]

With advanced AI security, compliance, and oversight frameworks, we ensure that autonomous AI operations align with ethical standards and business objectives.

[/et_pb_toggle][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" width="90%" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" custom_padding="||||false|false" border_color_bottom="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22border_color_bottom%22%93}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/planet-volumes-n90vqb47E7M-unsplash.jpg" title_text="planet-volumes-n90vqb47E7M-unsplash" force_fullwidth="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" border_radii="on|16px|16px|16px|16px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.71em" header_2_font="|600|||||||" header_2_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" header_2_font_size="48px" custom_margin="||40px||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_2_text_color%22%93}"]

Why Choose M&S Consulting for Agentic AI?

At M&S, we take a holistic approach to AI implementation—ensuring that AI agents not only integrate smoothly with your enterprise ecosystem but also operate securely and efficiently. Our team of experts brings deep experience in AI strategy, governance, and infrastructure, making us the ideal partner to navigate the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

The future of AI is agentic, adaptive, and intelligent. Are you ready to integrate AI agents that think, plan, and act autonomously to drive business success?

Our expert AI consultants can help you with…

Safely Integrating AI into Your Business

In today's AI-driven world, businesses are understandably concerned with the safety and ethical considerations of incorporating AI into their operations. 

At M&S, we recognize the critical importance of AI safety for your business.

At M&S, we prioritize ethical practices, robust security measures, and transparency. Our dedicated team is there every step of the way to ensure your AI integration is both responsible and secure.

Embrace the potential of AI with confidence, knowing your business is in safe hands with M&S Consulting as your guide. For more information on safety or to address any specific concerns, we invite you to get in touch with us.

Artificial Intelligence Consulting

SecureAI-driven transformation at your fingertips.

Artificial Intelligence (AI)
is more than just a buzzword. It’s a transformative tool that’s rippling across every industry – changing the way people work and do business at a fundamental level.
For 20 years, M&S Consulting has been harnessing the power of AI to give businesses the strategic competitive advantage that propels them into the future. Our seasoned team of AI professionals is here to safely and efficiently integrate strategies for businesses looking to leverage AI and Machine Learning Capabilities.
Ready to lead your company into the future?
 
Let M&S Consulting take you there!
Schedule a Call
Unlocking the Power of Agentic AI for Your Organization
AI is evolving beyond simple automation—Agentic AI introduces a new paradigm where AI systems autonomously plan, execute, and adapt tasks to achieve business goals with minimal human intervention. These AI agents don’t just follow pre-set rules; they dynamically assess objectives, resources, and constraints, then devise and iterate solutions in real time, even changing course when things get off track.
AI systems can now function as collaborative agents—one generating content while another validates compliance or quality. Agent interactions are orchestrated through centralized platforms such as AgentForce—leading to enhanced productivity across inter-departmental and multi-party business functions.At M&S Consulting, we help organizations harness Agentic AI to unlock greater efficiency, scalability, and strategic intelligence. Whether it’s integrating AI-driven decision-making into enterprise systems, developing smart human-machine workflow automation, or ensuring governance over autonomous AI processes, we provide the expertise to make Agentic AI work for you.

How Can Agentic AI Transform Your Business?

Automated Decision-Making & Execution
AI agents can assess complex data inputs, generate insights, and autonomously take action—streamlining decision-making while reducing human workload.
Enterprise AI Integration
Our solutions connect Agentic AI with your existing systems, from Salesforce, SAP, and Oracle to proprietary applications—ensuring a seamless and secure AI-driven workflow.
AI-Driven Business Optimization
From predictive analytics to intelligent process automation, AI agents optimize workflows by dynamically adjusting to changing business needs.
Secure and Ethical AI Governance
With advanced AI security, compliance, and oversight frameworks, we ensure that autonomous AI operations align with ethical standards and business objectives.
Why Choose M&S Consulting for Agentic AI?
At M&S, we take a holistic approach to AI implementation—ensuring that AI agents not only integrate smoothly with your enterprise ecosystem but also operate securely and efficiently. Our team of experts brings deep experience in AI strategy, governance, and infrastructure, making us the ideal partner to navigate the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
The future of AI is agentic, adaptive, and intelligent. Are you ready to integrate AI agents that think, plan, and act autonomously to drive business success?
Schedule a Call
Our expert AI consultants can help you with…
agsdix-smt2-map

AI Strategy & Roadmap

Start racking up quick wins by creating a practical AI implementation roadmap.
agsdix-smt2-gavel

Security & Governance for AI

Protect data with secure AI solutions that are informed by AI policy, reinforced by end-user training, and backed by human oversight.
agsdix-smt1-equalizer

Data Architecture for AI

Create a robust data fabric that provides the necessary capabilities to support timely, well-informed decision-making across your organization.
agsdix-smt2-low-priority

Smart Workflow Automation

Streamline everyday operations by automating repetitive processes and creating optimized human-machine workflows.
agsdix-smt2-insert-emoticon

User Adoption of AI

Ensure successful adoption of AI capabilities by all stakeholders through reliable results, simple-to-use web applications, and valuable in-context, on-demand user training.
agsdix-smt1-code

AI Application Development

Better utilize AI features in your current technology stack, integrate AI-based solutions to improve specific processes, or develop new AI solutions unique to your industry and organization.
agsdix-smt1-cloud-done

Cloud Infrastructure and AIOps

Enhance operational agility and efficiency while delivering peak system performance through exceptional management of your digital infrastructure. M&S supports AWS, Azure, Google, IBM, Oracle, and Salesforce cloud platforms.
agsdix-smt1-assistant

AI Integration with Enterprise Systems

Combine the power of AI with the data and functionality within your core Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft 365 systems and see efficiency improvement, error reduction, and a better, more personalized customer experience.
“Using AI, M&S developed an innovative solution that is much better, much faster, and much less expensive than our previous process. Very rare to get all three benefits at once.”

– Senior Partner, International Law Firm

Embrace Digital Transformation with Expert-led AI Strategy.
When it comes to digital strategy, AI has changed the game – and you don’t want to be late. 
At M&S Consulting, we don’t just implement AI; we empower organizations to thrive in the digital era. Our expert team helps you build a high-performing AI strategy around the unique needs of your organization.
We bring traditional know-how along with modern technology expertise to the table, making us uniquely qualified to guide your organization from old to new, leading to incredible transformation across multiple business areas.

Unleashing Untapped Potential

Business Optimization

Innovation Catalyst

Gaining Strategic Advantage in Competitive Landscape

Market Leadership

Mitigating Risks and Ensuring Compliance

Ethical AI Practices
Ensure your AI strategy aligns with ethical standards and compliance requirements.

Safely Integrating AI into Your Business

In today’s AI-driven world, businesses are understandably concerned with the safety and ethical considerations of incorporating AI into their operations. 
At M&S, we recognize the critical importance of AI safety for your business.

With almost two decades of experience implementing AI strategies across various industries, we can say with confidence that integrating AI into your business can be both innovative and safe.
At M&S, we prioritize ethical practices, robust security measures, and transparency. Our dedicated team is there every step of the way to ensure your AI integration is both responsible and secure.
Embrace the potential of AI with confidence, knowing your business is in safe hands with M&S Consulting as your guide. For more information on safety or to address any specific concerns, we invite you to get in touch with us.

DevOps can empower your organization to deploy with higher speed and quality—but integrating this framework into an enterprise cohesively can be quite challenging. 

Let our consultants harness the power of cloud computing to seamlessly integrate DevOps into your operations, enabling your teams to work more efficiently and deliver better results faster.

IaaS & PaaS

We specialize in the two key components of cloud computing: Infrastructure as a Service and Platform as a Service. Instead of working with a separate consulting team for each need, you can leverage our comprehensive expertise. 

Cloud Infrastructure empowers you to leave behind outdated legacy systems and switch to on-demand serverless data storage and management. As a consulting collective with a rich history, we’re experts of both the old and the new—meaning we can help you bridge the gap between the two seamlessly. 

Cloud Platforms provide the essential hardware and software businesses need to develop powerful applications. Our team will handle the heavy lifting to help you adopt and utilize these solutions so you can focus more of your energy on fueling innovation.

Multi-Cloud Solutions

Want to mix and match different capabilities from a diverse array of cloud vendors? We’ll help you tailor a multi-cloud environment that meets the exact needs of your organization. We have extensive experience working with Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Salesforce, and more. 

This rare depth of knowledge enables us to provide valuable insights and guidance on the most effective ways to leverage each cloud platform, considering its unique strengths and limitations.

Cloud & Infrustructure Consulting

Optimize your efficiency and scale effortlessly through the dynamic capabilities of cloud technology.

With the power of cloud computing, businesses often no longer need to manage outdated on-premises servers, which can be costly and burdensome to scale.

But if your business was built on traditional systems, evolving into a serverless, cloud-based organization may seem overwhelming.

That's where we come in

Our experts have over 20 years of experience designing and implementing personalized cloud strategies that modernize businesses like yours from the ground up. Plus, we specialize in hybrid and multi-cloud environments, meaning we meet you right where you’re at and take you exactly where you want to go. 
Whether you’re just starting your cloud journey or looking to perfect an existing setup, our team is ready to address your most critical business challenges and objectives—all while staying within your budget.
Let us leverage the right cloud technologies to optimize your operations and deliver the maximum return on your investment.
Schedule a Call
M&S Consulting Cloud & Infrastructure Services
Our expert cloud consultants can help you with…
agsdix-smt1-assignment-turned-in

Strategy and Planning

No two organizations are the same—and neither are their cloud requirements. 
Want to blend the best of both on-prem and cloud solutions? We can make it happen. 
Want to pick and choose different products and services from separate cloud providers? We’ve got you there, too. 
We design and implement tailored cloud solutions that ensure optimal performance, cost-efficiency, and alignment with your unique needs.
agsdix-smt1-cloud-upload

Migration and Infrastructure

Whether you need to build a brand new cloud solution from scratch or upgrade an existing data center using your preferred cloud or virtualization vendor, our consultants are here to help.
We’ll make the process of storing, organizing, and managing your data within cloud infrastructure smooth, fast, and hassle-free—all while causing minimal disruption to your operations.
We make going serverless absolutely seamless. 
agsdix-smt1-add-circle

Ongoing Support and Optimization

Cloud solutions aren’t a “set it and forget it” kind of investment.
Cloud technology continues to evolve at a rapid pace every day.
With our expert advisory, you can ensure that you’re taking full advantage of the most cutting-edge cloud innovations and reaping the highest ROI on your chosen solutions.
agsdix-smt1-beenhere

Security Services

Moving your data from on-prem to the cloud requires robust protections, and that’s where our security specialists come in. 
When we design cloud infrastructure, we build security into every layer from day one. 
This approach protects your peace of mind and reputation while also keeping you fully compliant with industry regulations.
agsdix-smt2-local-atm

Cost Analysis

Estimates suggest that about 30% of cloud spend is wasted. 
How can you make sure you’re using the most effective cloud technology to achieve your business objectives while also minimizing the amount of money you need to spend on cloud resources? 
The answer is simple—you allow our seasoned advisors to guide your cloud infrastructure financial strategy. 
agsdix-smt1-filter-tilt-shift

DevOps Integration

DevOps is a methodology that promotes collaboration between your development (Dev) and operations (Ops) teams. 
DevOps can empower your organization to deploy with higher speed and quality—but integrating this framework into an enterprise cohesively can be quite challenging. 
Let our consultants harness the power of cloud computing to seamlessly integrate DevOps into your operations, enabling your teams to work more efficiently and deliver better results faster.
Maximize Agility and Minimize Costs
On-prem servers may have sufficed in the past, but it’s clear that cloud infrastructure is the way of the future. We’re here to help you break free from the limits of legacy systems and take full advantage of the flexibility only cloud solutions can offer.
Our experienced cloud specialists will help you leverage the unmatched freedom, utility, and scalability of cloud solutions to meet your constantly evolving business demands. Let us help you unlock stronger security, better cost-efficiency, faster innovation, increased sustainability, more reliable data loss prevention and recovery, and so much more—all through the power of the cloud.
Enhance Your Operations with Agentic AI
Agentic AI is unlocking new possibilities by enabling systems to plan, reason, and act independently to drive smarter business outcomes.
We implement Agentic AI into your business, helping streamline workflows, enhance decision-making, and unlock new efficiencies. Whether you need to optimize processes, improve responsiveness, or scale innovation, our AI expertise ensures seamless integration and tangible results.
Schedule a Call
THE M&S ADVANTAGE
What Makes Us a Superior Cloud Partner
IaaS & PaaS
We specialize in the two key components of cloud computing: Infrastructure as a Service and Platform as a Service. Instead of working with a separate consulting team for each need, you can leverage our comprehensive expertise. 
Cloud Infrastructure empowers you to leave behind outdated legacy systems and switch to on-demand serverless data storage and management. As a consulting collective with a rich history, we’re experts of both the old and the new—meaning we can help you bridge the gap between the two seamlessly. 
Cloud Platforms provide the essential hardware and software businesses need to develop powerful applications. Our team will handle the heavy lifting to help you adopt and utilize these solutions so you can focus more of your energy on fueling innovation.
“A consulting team that can only help you utilize a single cloud provider is like a mechanic who only knows how to use one tool. Or a DJ who only plays one artist.”
Multi-Cloud Solutions
Want to mix and match different capabilities from a diverse array of cloud vendors? We’ll help you tailor a multi-cloud environment that meets the exact needs of your organization. We have extensive experience working with Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Salesforce, and more. 
This rare depth of knowledge enables us to provide valuable insights and guidance on the most effective ways to leverage each cloud platform, considering its unique strengths and limitations.
Hybrid Solutions

Want to utilize a combination of both public and private clouds, plus on-prem infrastructure?

When you work with M&S, you can enjoy the best of all worlds. 
Our team is here to help you integrate your data across each environment seamlessly—creating a unified infrastructure that’s flexible yet cohesive.

It's Safer

Experience theft or a disaster that damages your legacy systems?
Let your local servers get a little too old before replacing them?
Spill coffee on the computer that houses that one critical file?

All of these situations could be devastating for a business that relies solely on physical, on-prem systems. But for organizations that have invested in cloud infrastructure with M&S, they’re barely an inconvenience.

It's Smarter

Psst… Did you know data is the secret weapon of the world’s top-performing enterprises?

It’s true! When you know better, you can do better, and cloud infrastructure makes it effortless to track, store, and analyze essential operational data so you can make more informed decisions and optimize your efficiency. 
Learn more about our Data Analytics & Integration services.

It’s More Cost-Effective

Experience a period of rapid growth and need to scale up your systems? No problem. 

Dip into a slow season and want to stop paying for the resources you don’t currently need? You got it. 

With the cloud, these transitions can be made seamlessly and smoothly. Meet your constantly changing business demands effortlessly without ever paying a penny more than you need to.

It's More Connected

Make your business data accessible to employees no matter where they are with the convenience of cloud-based platforms. 
 
Empower your team members to share, view, and utilize up-to-date information seamlessly. 
With the cloud, you can easily cultivate a culture of communication and collaboration across your entire enterprise.

The good news? They don’t need to.

At M&S Consulting, staff augmentation is our core strength—we’ve been supplementing teams like yours and amplifying their outcomes for over 20 years. A Deeply Connected Network of Expertise

When a traditional staffing firm brings you a hire, you’re only getting the isolated value of one person’s experience.

When M&S assigns a consultant to you, that professional is backed by the rich collective experience of our whole team—including leaders with decades of experience.

This ensures you benefit not just from one perspective, but from the depth and breadth of our entire team—250 members strong and still growing.

Unlike traditional staffing firms whose leaders often stem from sales or recruiting, our leadership team comes from real-world backgrounds delivering digital solutions.

This hands-on expertise is embedded in everything we do. We know what it takes to build a team that gets things done and delivers results.

An Introduction to M&S Consulting from CES 2025

Discover how M&S Consulting helped a major media client streamline their billing and invoicing process, turning a fragmented, multi-page nightmare into a unified, future-ready solution. In the blog, you’ll see how our experts combined SAP BRIM, S/4HANA, and Convergent Mediation to simplify complex billing, ensure data accuracy, and deliver an improved customer experience—all on a tight timeline and budget.
Read the Case Study
Learn how M&S Consulting transforms complex technology ecosystems into streamlined, future-ready platforms. In this one-page overview, you’ll see how our team of over 250 experts can help unify your IT landscape. We’ve proven our expertise across both the private and public sectors, delivering cultural alignment, staff upskilling, and managed services that keep your operations running smoothly.
See What We Do

item.excerpt:encoded: Use the same M&S talent to speed up your Salesforce projects and achieve development goals.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
M&S Brasil

Enhancing your organization with Salesforce for less

Schedule a Call
Why Nearshore Services
Same M&S talent to speed up your Salesforce projects and achieve development goals
Schedule a Call
Brasil has incredible market potential and a very talented pool of workers
A more cost-effective option compared to US-based developers
Brazilian professionals offer cultural compatibility, adapting well to US corporate culture
Brasil’s extensive pool of talented developers is fluent in multiple languages, including English
Similar working hours to the US allows for easy and effective collaboration on projects with hybrid teams
Our Services
Salesforce implementation and development (Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Component (LWC)), including digital experience pages and mobile apps.
 
Let’s enhance your business with Salesforce 
Sales Cloud
Service Cloud
Health Cloud
Field Service
Schedule a Call
Flows: Low-Code Automation to Drive Efficiency

Streamline Operations

A low-code solution to automate processes without heavy development.

Data Synchronization

Ensure data consistency across teams—everyone works with the same accurate information.

Custom User Interfaces

Create intuitive, user-friendly screens to make data entry simple and efficient for your teams.

Real-Time Workflows

Automate multi-step workflows that keep everyone informed with real-time notifications.
Lightning Web Components

Latest Salesforce Technology

Built on Salesforce’s most advanced and performant framework, LWCs are fast, reliable, and secure.

Highly Customizable UIs

Achieve granular control over your user interfaces, tailored to meet even the most complex business requirements.
Apex: Unlock Advanced Capabilities

Complex Business Logic

Apex enables advanced customizations and automations that go beyond the capabilities of Flows.Example: Automatically calculate discounts based on customer history or tiered pricing structures.

Performance and Scalability

Handle large data volumes and complex operations effortlessly.Why It Matters: As your business grows, Apex ensures Salesforce can keep up with increased demands without compromising performance.

System Integrations

Seamlessly connect Salesforce to other platforms without requiring additional middleware.Example: Sync data with your ERP or e-commerce system for a unified view of operations.
Who We Support
Organizations Open to Nearshore Development

Companies comfortable with outsourcing development tasks to nearshore teams for cost-efficiency and flexibility.
Businesses looking for high-quality development at competitive rates.

Teams Needing Specific Development Enhancements

Organizations that manage Salesforce but need help implementing one-off, custom solutions.
Advanced customizations like building LWCs, integrating Salesforce with external systems, or implementing Apex-based logic.
Quick, expert implementation of specific projects without committing to long-term staffing.

Salesforce Teams Needing Developer Support

Internal teams maintaining Salesforce who lack in-house development expertise or resources.
Ongoing support for bug fixes, enhancements, and new features.
Reliable, on-demand developer support to complement their admin capabilities.

Salesforce Implementation Partners

Consulting firms or teams actively implementing Salesforce for their clients.
Additional developer capacity to handle customizations, integrations, and advanced configurations during projects.
A trusted development partner who ensures they deliver high-quality solutions on time.

Tech-Savvy Business Leaders Exploring Cost Optimization

Business leaders who want high-quality Salesforce customizations but are mindful of budget constraints.
Cost-effective development resources without sacrificing expertise or results.
Nearshore development offers an attractive balance of cost savings and quality.

Rapid Agility withComprehensive Capability

An Introduction to M&S Consulting from AFCEA West

Government & Diversity Designations
SeaPort NxG Prime Contract HolderM&S Consulting is a prime contract holder on the U.S. Navy’s SeaPort Next Generation (SeaPort NxG) vehicle, enabling streamlined access to professional support services across Navy ordering activities.
SBA HUBZone Certified, Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB), Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB)
Access to contract vehicles:

FBI ITSSS-2 – Prime
NASA SEWP V

GSA Multi-Award Schedule (MAS) Contract:GS-35F-0231S SIN: 54151S
NAICS Codes: 541430, 541511*, 541512, 541513, 51519, 541990, 541611, 51614, 51618, 518210 (*Primary)
Numerous contracts with Federal, State and Local, and Education clients
Hiring our Heroes, Talent Alliance, and Pledge 1%

THE M&S ADVANTAGE
What Makes Us a Superior Public Sector Partner
We help public sector teams get critical work done. We’re known for being easy to work with, hard on problems, and accountable through delivery, bringing secure, practical modernization that supports the mission first.
M&S Consulting brings deep technical expertise, disciplined program execution, and a partner mindset shaped by decades of federal experience.
Our Public Sector Expertise
With expertise across all Salesforce clouds, our team leverages over 500,000 hours of hands-on experience annually to guide clients through digital transformation. From automation and integration to custom development, we ensure scalable, tailored implementations that drive innovation, efficiency, and long-term success.
Our Salesforce Capability
M&S Consulting empowers Sea Service leaders with tailored SAP solutions to enhance operational readiness and adapt to evolving threats. As an SAP PartnerEdge partner, we specialize in SAP Brim and digital transformation, delivering scalable, mission-ready capabilities. Partner with us to drive innovation, reliability, and operational excellence in a complex landscape.
SAP Expertise
With expertise across private, public, hybrid, and government cloud environments, we provide tailored solutions for seamless migrations, cloud-native architecture, and secure operations. Our certified team leverages IaaS, PaaS, and DevOps expertise to help businesses scale efficiently and securely.
Cloud and Infrastructure
Discover How M&S Consulting Drives Digital Transformation
Since 2002, M&S Consulting has delivered exceptional results for commercial and public sector clients, leveraging a team of 250+ experts to help our clients succeed. We’re here to guide your organization’s transformation to cutting-edge systems with precision and a personal touch.
Learn More
Unlock the Human Side of Technology with our podcast Human Coded
Discover Human Coded, the podcast that explores the intersection of people, technology, and business, offering inspiring stories and actionable insights to navigate the digital landscape.

INVESTOR COLLABORATIVE

ABetter Path Forwardfor Founders and Funders

The Investor Collaborative streamlines how innovation gets funded, developed, and brought to market. Sponsored by M&S Ventures, this initiative connects investors, founders, and co-development partners to accelerate high-impact projects with clarity and momentum. Whether you’re deploying capital, building a solution, or navigating government funding, we make it easier to say yes and move forward.

What We Bring to the Table

agsdix-smt1-code

Strategic Co-Development

We don’t just advise. We co-build. Through M&S Consulting, we actively partner on strategic projects by assembling expert teams, securing contracts, and delivering outcomes. If you’ve got a promising solution and a clear use case, we’re ready to bridge the gap between idea and execution.
agsdix-smt1-filter-center-focus

Deal Facilitation and Opportunity Matching

We identify and shape opportunities that make sense for everyone involved. From special-purpose engagements to scalable co-development projects, we help founders and investors confidently move quickly.
agsdix-smt1-account-balance

Government and Public Sector Navigation

Breaking into public sector work should not take years. We’ve helped ventures unlock MAP funding, navigate procurement hurdles, and secure federal contracts. We’ll help you avoid unnecessary delays and get to work.

Why Partner with M&S?

agsdix-fab fa-digital-ocean

Over 20 years of experience leading digital transformation projects

agsdix-smt2-people

Deep relationships across commercial and public sectors

agsdix-smt2-insert-chart

Proven ability to scale people, processes, and technology

agsdix-fas fa-shield-alt

Certified Woman-Owned Small Business with Top-Secret Facility Clearance

A New Kind of Collaborative

The Investor Collaborative is built around real ventures making a real impact. We’re not just talking about collaboration—we’re living it. M&S Ventures has partnered with forward-thinking founders and startups across a diverse set of industries and markets. Some of the ventures we’ve supported include:

Monarch Learning Labs

A flexible training platform tailored for regulated industries like healthcare and advanced manufacturing.

get2there

A mobility scheduling tool built to improve access to transportation for vulnerable and underserved populations.

Braided

A giving platform that empowers collaborative decision-making and transparent resource-sharing within communities.

GTD Speech

A tool designed by and for speech-language pathologists to simplify transcription and streamline documentation.

Growmentum

A growth enablement platform helping small businesses scale with sustainable, data-informed strategies.

M Studios

A marketing and brand consultancy offering strategic design, content, and digital execution for purpose-driven organizations.

MTN Craft

An initiative focused on spotlighting Appalachian innovation through artisan products and locally-inspired digital solutions.

Moodr

A proactive remote patient-monitoring platform that pairs AI-driven data with guided outreach to catch and address behavioral-health risks.
These ventures reflect the range of work possible through this collaborative, from early-stage to established, local to national. We support entrepreneurs who are building what’s next.
Let’s build something together

Are you an investor, founder, or public-sector leader looking for aligned opportunities and trusted partners?
Let’s talk.

Contact Us

item.title: Embracing Multi-Cloud Expertise: M&S Consulting's Advantage in the Growing Multi-Cloud Landscape
item.dc:creator: ashok.aggarwal
item.content:encoded:
In today's dynamic digital landscape, organizations across various sectors are increasingly seeking ways to improve their IT infrastructure and streamline their operations. Cloud technologies have emerged as a critical component of modern IT strategies, with a multitude of cloud service providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) offering diverse solutions. The growing trend of multi-cloud adoption in enterprise environments highlights the importance of partnering with a systems integrator (like us), which has expertise across multiple cloud platforms. This blog post will delve into the prevalence of multi-cloud strategies, the advantages of M&S's multi-cloud expertise, and the challenges organizations face when managing multiple clouds.

The Multi-Cloud Landscape

Multi-cloud strategies are increasingly popular in enterprise environments and are expected to grow in the mid-market as well. According to a recent study by Flexera, 89% of enterprises are using multiple cloud providers, showcasing the widespread adoption of multi-cloud strategies. Despite this growing trend, many organizations face challenges in finding and nurturing talent with deep expertise across multiple cloud platforms. This skills gap makes it difficult for organizations to make informed decisions about when to use which cloud service provider (CSP), and how to navigate the intricacies and nuances of each platform.

The M&S Multi-Cloud Advantage

Our team stands out in the multi-cloud landscape, as our leads have extensive experience working with two to three, if not all four, of the major CSPs. This depth of knowledge enables us to provide valuable insights and guidance on the most effective ways to leverage each cloud platform, considering its unique capabilities and limitations. By partnering with M&S, your organization gains access to the following advantages:

Informed Decision-Making

Our deep understanding of the major CSPs empowers us to help organizations make informed decisions about which provider(s) to use for specific needs. We analyze each platform's strengths and weaknesses and align them with your organization's objectives, ensuring that you choose the right provider to optimize your IT infrastructure.

Tailored Solutions

No two organizations are the same, and neither are their IT requirements. M&S Consulting's multi-cloud expertise enables us to design and implement tailored solutions that leverage the strengths of each CSP, ensuring optimal performance, cost-efficiency, and alignment with your unique needs.

Holistic Multi-Cloud Management

Managing multiple cloud platforms can be complex, but M&S Consulting's comprehensive knowledge of each CSP allows us to streamline the process for your organization. We help navigate the challenges associated with multi-cloud management, ensuring that you can focus on driving business outcomes.

Bridging the Skills Gap

As mentioned earlier, one of the key challenges organizations face when adopting a multi-cloud strategy is the lack of talent with deep expertise across multiple cloud platforms. By partnering with us, you gain access to a team of professionals who possess the knowledge and experience needed to make the most of your multi-cloud investments.

The growing prevalence of multi-cloud strategies underscores the importance of partnering with a systems integrator with expertise across multiple cloud platforms. Our deep understanding of AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI enables us to provide tailored solutions, informed decision-making, holistic multi-cloud management, and bridge the skills gap that many organizations face. By choosing M&S Consulting as your multi-cloud partner, your organization will be well-positioned to harness the power of the cloud and thrive in the digital age. We'd love to talk to you about your business needs, visit the Contact Us page and let's get the conversation started.

Clear requirements are crucial for leveraging technology investments. We provide expert business analysis to handle requirements engineering, process, and data management. Our Business Analysts bridge the gap, translating your business needs to technical teams and aiding in technology adoption across the organization.

You need the right vendor to deliver the right technology solution. We manage the vendor analysis and selection process with an unbiased, multi-criteria approach that allows us to partner with you in determining which solution will best meet the needs of your organization.

Processes can become outdated and inefficient if not regularly assessed and improved. We leverage deep experience and proven methodologies to identify pain points and inefficiencies within current processes, enhancing productivity and streamlining operations.

Health checks allow an organization to identify common issues with a given project – M&S will not only conduct these health checks, we will also help you resolve any identified issues in a way that’s both cost-effective and scalable to future projects.

Mergers and acquisitions are an important business strategy—but they require a large investment of time and money. M&S offers proven strategies and expertise to ensure a more seamless integration for both entities so you can begin realizing the financial and operational benefits of the M&A as quickly as possible.

Agile Project Management

Expected deliverables—done right, done on time, and within budget.

PMaaS stands for ‘Project Management as a Service’. Our clients are invited to utilize these project management services on-demand. At M&S, we know the value of a well-executed project. That’s why we provide highly-skilled professionals who can jump in and hit the ground running on any project.
There’s no sugarcoating it: strategic project management is critical to success. Yet many businesses find themselves stretched thin, with valuable project deliverables falling through the cracks.
That’s where we come in. 
For over 20 years, M&S Consulting has served organizations like yours with time-tested methods and best practices for project management.
Ready to get work done faster and more effectively?
Let M&S Consulting take you there!
Schedule a Call

What’s included with PMaaS?

Our expert project management consultants help with…

Project Portfolio Management

A strategic approach is used to manage and prioritize a collection of projects (the portfolio) to achieve specific business objectives. PPM focuses on selecting, prioritizing, and managing a group of projects to ensure they align with the organization’s strategic goals, provide maximum value, and utilize resources effectively.

Project Rescue & Recovery

We help rescue projects from “in the red” status and swiftly pivot towards recovery! We have the expertise required to not only recognize the issues leading to imminent failure but quickly get a failing project back on track and on to successful completion.

New Technology Implementation

New technology can transform a business. While everyone wants the latest technology, in-house expertise can be a hurdle. We provide the expertise to seamlessly integrate any technology into your organization, taking your operations and growth to the next level. 

Change Management

Business transformation goes beyond implementing a new tool. To fully reap the benefits, you must drive organizational change, from people to processes. We provide proven strategies for process blueprinting, communications, and training, along with top talent to execute them effectively.

Business Analysis

Clear requirements are crucial for leveraging technology investments. We provide expert business analysis to handle requirements engineering, process, and data management. Our Business Analysts bridge the gap, translating your business needs to technical teams and aiding in technology adoption across the organization.

Vendor Analysis & Selection

You need the right vendor to deliver the right technology solution. We manage the vendor analysis and selection process with an unbiased, multi-criteria approach that allows us to partner with you in determining which solution will best meet the needs of your organization.

Process Improvement

Processes can become outdated and inefficient if not regularly assessed and improved. We leverage deep experience and proven methodologies to identify pain points and inefficiencies within current processes, enhancing productivity and streamlining operations.  

Project Health Assessment

Health checks allow an organization to identify common issues with a given project – M&S will not only conduct these health checks, we will also help you resolve any identified issues in a way that’s both cost-effective and scalable to future projects. 

M&A Integration

Mergers and acquisitions are an important business strategy—but they require a large investment of time and money. M&S offers proven strategies and expertise to ensure a more seamless integration for both entities so you can begin realizing the financial and operational benefits of the M&A as quickly as possible.
According to PMI research, one of the top three delivery challenges is having the right people with the right skills for priority projects. In a 2020 survey by the Project Management Institute (PMI), one in six respondents identified the lack of talent with the appropriate skills as the primary reason for project failures in their organization.
PMaaS with M&S Consulting
What our team brings to the table
agsdix-smt1-done-all

Leadership

We bring exceptional project leadership, something that requires skill in both management and leadership. Project leadership is a soft skill; part art, part science.
agsdix-smt1-assistant

Expertise

We come with deep reservoirs of industry knowledge and expertise, enabling us to tackle any and every project. 
agsdix-smt1-flag

Focus

We manage the process, so you don’t have to. Our goal is to supplement your staff or completely handle the project so that you and your team are free to carry on with business as usual.
agsdix-smt1-clear-all

Perspective

We come in with fresh eyes and take an honest look at the organization, identifying opportunities for improvement along the way – Done.Better.Together.
agsdix-smt1-aspect-ratio

Flexibility & Scalability

We come when you need us; on-demand PMaaS means we can flex to changing needs and handle multiple, even competing, priorities and stakeholders.
agsdix-smt2-low-priority

Reduced Risk

We bring project management experts. In addition to delivering expertise, those experts serve as a lookout for signs of problems and known dangers—reducing risk and likelihood of delays.
agsdix-smt1-attach-money

Cost Savings

With PMaaS, you only pay for what you need. No FTE. Just keeping projects moving forward as needed.
agsdix-smt1-credit-card

Vendor Management

We manage external vendors and ensure follow-through on the deliverables that add value to your project and organization.
Our Approach to PMaaS
Project management addresses a critical need for organizations facing more projects than they have time to complete. Traditional project managers tend to employ methodologies that focus on activities rather than outcomes. 
M&S Consulting’s PMaaS shifts this approach by strategically managing projects to achieve specific objectives. In doing so, we enable greater effectiveness through increased accountability, improved communication, streamlined processes, and deep expertise. Additionally, it provides an independent voice and perspective, further boosting project success.
How Can PMaaS Benefit Your Organization?
Project Management as a Service (PMaaS) keeps projects on track, taking your business to the next level sooner than your competition. Our team of seasoned experts brings the experience and the know-how to execute even the most complex projects flawlessly.

Software Security Control Implementation

Access Management

Who should have access to what, and for how long?

Your organization faces threats from all angles in today's zero-trust world—and simple authentication methods are no longer sufficient. Pulling from our extensive experience with leading access management solutions and techniques such as role-based access control (RBAC), our M&S security experts will secure your enterprise boundaries, endpoints, and applications, whether on-prem or in the cloud.

DevSecOps

Short for Development, Security, and Operations, DevSecOps is a framework we employ here at M&S. It means that we integrate security testing into every single step of the software development process, catching vulnerabilities early and fixing them before they become problematic.

Containerization

Containerization isolates applications by bundling a workload’s code with everything it needs to run on any infrastructure. This not only boosts security but also makes coding and deployment more efficient, ensuring your other applications remain secure even if one is compromised.

Security for APIs

Application Programming Interfaces act as middlemen, helping two applications communicate with one another. APIs are connected to sensitive data—and that means they’re a prime target for attacks. We’re here to help you identify and resolve any vulnerabilities before they put you at risk.

At M&S Consulting, we’re here to make implementing enterprise-wide security measures effortless, efficient, and impactful. 

Our security experts make it simple to protect what matters most.

Cybersecurity Consulting

Put an end to emergencies — protect your digital assets, reputation, and peace of mind.

In today’s world, safeguarding data is only possible with a proactive and comprehensive security strategy. To combat constantly evolving threats, a strong defense is essential.
At M&S Consulting, we have over 20 years of experience helping organizations build security systems that are robust yet agile. Our smart solutions prevent costly disasters and ensure regulatory compliance—resulting in significant cost savings that far exceed your initial investment.
That’s where we come in. 
Let our seasoned team serve as your trusted security partner, fortifying your business with the protection you need to withstand any threat. 

Schedule a Call

Cybersecurity Ventures predicts that cybercrime will cost the global economy $10.5 trillion annually in 2025

Enhance Your Security Operations with Agentic AI
Agentic AI is unlocking new possibilities by enabling systems to plan, reason, and act independently to drive smarter business outcomes.
We implement Agentic AI into your business, helping streamline workflows, enhance decision-making, and unlock new efficiencies. Whether you need to optimize processes, improve responsiveness, or scale innovation, our AI expertise ensures seamless integration and tangible results.
Schedule a Call
How to Protect Business Data
Our elite security consultants specialize in…
Software Security Control Implementation
Identity Management
Access Management
DevSecOps
Containerization
Security for AI
Security for APIs
Software Security Control Implementation
To comply with increasingly stringent regulations, organizations must apply complex security controls at every level of their software systems. From deploying a comprehensive security system to strengthening your data loss prevention strategies to securing and encrypting data, we’re poised and ready to improve your security posture.
Identity Management
Modern organizations need to manage user identities across a diverse range of applications and populations. To streamline this process, we design and implement advanced identity solutions tailored to the unique needs of your organization. Allow us to increase the efficiency of your identity practices while mitigating security risks.
Access Management
Who should have access to what, and for how long?
Your organization faces threats from all angles in today’s zero-trust world—and simple authentication methods are no longer sufficient. Pulling from our extensive experience with leading access management solutions and techniques such as role-based access control (RBAC), our M&S security experts will secure your enterprise boundaries, endpoints, and applications, whether on-prem or in the cloud. 
DevSecOps
Short for Development, Security, and Operations, DevSecOps is a framework we employ here at M&S. It means that we integrate security testing into every single step of the software development process, catching vulnerabilities early and fixing them before they become problematic.
Containerization
Containerization isolates applications by bundling a workload’s code with everything it needs to run on any infrastructure. This not only boosts security but also makes coding and deployment more efficient, ensuring your other applications remain secure even if one is compromised.
Security for AI
Is your business excited by the possibilities of AI but intimidated by its uncertainties?
Our team helps you leverage AI responsibly—ensuring compliance, protecting private data, and preserving customer trust by addressing the unique risks posed by AI.
Security for APIs
Application Programming Interfaces act as middlemen, helping two applications communicate with one another. APIs are connected to sensitive data—and that means they’re a prime target for attacks. We’re here to help you identify and resolve any vulnerabilities before they put you at risk.

Safeguard Your Digital Assets with Our Robust Cybersecurity Solutions

Investing in security is kind of like buying insurance. Sure, it might not be the most exciting thing in the world to set up—but when a threat inevitably emerges, you’ll be relieved you had the foresight to prepare.
With a strong security strategy on your side, you can successfully scale your business to soaring new heights. On the other hand, when you don’t have proper protections in place, your organization won’t have the solid foundation it needs to make meaningful, uninhibited progress. 
At M&S Consulting, we’re here to make implementing enterprise-wide security measures effortless, efficient, and impactful. 
Our security experts make it simple to protect what matters most.
How M&S Goes the Extra Mile
Strengthening Digital Security
agsdix-smt2-person-pin

Personalized Strategy

Our security experts begin by evaluating your business to identify weak points and develop a personalized, cost-effective plan for protecting your data and reducing risk.
agsdix-smt1-bookmark

Staff Training

Cyberattacks often exploit human error. That’s why safety-conscious enterprises embed security best practices into every level of their operations. We’re here to help you cultivate a security-first culture by training your team to adopt a cautious, zero-trust mindset.
agsdix-smt1-blur-on

Ongoing Evolution

As technology evolves, so do the tactics of bad actors. With our help, you can ensure that your organization remains aligned with all of the most advanced strategies for security—staying one step ahead of threats at all times. 
Digital Security Benefits Our Clients Enjoy
Digital Data Protected 
From sensitive business records and intellectual property to private information about your employees and clients, your organization has a big responsibility to keep its data safe. We’re here to fortify your defenses.
Regulatory Compliance Simplified
We navigate complex regulations for you, ensuring compliance and helping you steer clear of penalties, lawsuits, and reputational damage.
Costly Disasters Averted
With strong defensive measures, data backups, and early threat detection, we help you avoid and recover from potential cyberattacks.
Positive Reputation Strengthened
From sensitive business records and intellectual property to private information about your employees and clients, your organization has a big responsibility to keep its data safe. We’re here to fortify your defenses.
Peace of Mind Achieved
Confidence in your security is priceless.
Selected security solutions we work with
How Can Security Consulting Benefit Your Organization?
Security is a crucial pillar of your business—don’t leave it in the hands of anyone but the best. 

Ready to boost your defense?

Schedule a call today to talk with one of our experts.

Let us handle the heavy lifting of consolidating all your separate data sources into one organized, central spot.

We’re here to streamline your data storage practices and deepen your insights using advanced platforms like Snowflake, Oracle, Microsoft, and Amazon.

The difference between organizations that let their gut instinct guide them and those that make decisions based on evidence-based insights is staggering.

In order to truly integrate data into your business, you must go beyond surface-level solutions. Our experienced data scientists are here to help you harness and maximize your data, enabling your entire organization to boost efficiency, address weaknesses, and transform its outcomes.

With a strong security strategy on your side, you can successfully scale your business to soaring new heights. On the other hand, when you don’t have proper protections in place, your organization won’t have the solid foundation it needs to make meaningful, uninhibited progress. 

At M&S Consulting, we’re here to make implementing enterprise-wide security measures effortless, efficient, and impactful. 

Our security experts make it simple to protect what matters most.

We start by understanding the present state of your data strategy as well as the challenges you’re facing and your objectives for the future.

Then, with a focus on precision and practicality, we create and implement a roadmap for transforming your business into a data-driven enterprise.

From developing systems that continuously collect diverse sources of data, to securely storing and managing that data, to providing you with clear analytical reports that inform smarter decision-making, we’re here to make data your business’s greatest asset.

Data Analytics & Integration Consulting

Say goodbye to guesswork and hello to data-driven decision making in your business.

Modern businesses have more opportunities than ever before to gather data, analyze it, and use it to make improvements to their process. However, many struggle to unlock the full potential of their data.
Embracing a data-driven approach in your business is the key to making more informed decisions, optimizing your operation, and maintaining a competitive edge in your industry.
At M&S Consulting, we’ve spent over 20 years equipping clients to utilize comprehensive, specific data to work smarter and accelerate their growth.
That’s where we come in. 
Let our experienced consultants integrate applications that will resolve your most critical business challenges, streamline your systems, and elevate your efficiency.
Schedule a Call
According to a survey by Harvard Business Review, data-driven businesses outperform their peers in several key business metrics:
