CASE STUDY

[/et_pb_text][dipi_text_highlighter text_highlighter_prefix="Building a Robust Operations Power App to Replace a Maxed‑Out SharePoint Site" highlight_shape="curly-line-1" stroke_color="RGBA(255,255,255,0)" stroke_width="18px" highlight_line_cap="butt" shape_h_offset="-3px" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" all_text_font="|700|||||||" all_text_text_color="#FFFFFF" all_text_font_size="46px" all_text_line_height="1.2em" prefix_text_font="|700|||||||" highlighted_text_font="|700|||||||" custom_padding="0px|||||" all_text_font_size_tablet="36px" all_text_font_size_phone="36px" all_text_font_size_last_edited="on|tablet" global_colors_info="{}"][/dipi_text_highlighter][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.24.2" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/network-globe.jpg" title_text="network globe" disabled_on="on|on|off" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" width="90%" border_radii="on|20px|20px|20px|20px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800|||||||" text_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

INTRODUCTION

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" custom_padding="||0px|||" global_colors_info="{}"]

An internal SharePoint 2013 site was originally developed to support the safety review and operations permitting process for over 100 concurrent research and development projects. Over time, the system became increasingly inefficient and difficult to maintain. Researchers and managers were required to navigate a fragmented process involving outdated InfoPath forms, email-based approvals, manually updated spreadsheets, and document libraries that had exceeded practical limits.

As frustrations mounted, users expressed a clear preference for reverting to paper-based workflows rather than engaging with the existing system. Recognizing the operational and compliance risks associated with this legacy platform, the organization engaged M&S to design and implement a more robust, scalable solution.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/Sharepoint-Frustration-Large.jpeg" title_text="Sharepoint Frustration Large" align="center" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="74%" border_radii="on|20px|20px|20px|20px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The Challenge

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The existing system presented multiple technical and functional constraints. 

Each time an experiment was modified users were required to re-initiate the entire permitting process. This compounded administrative burden across hundreds of projects, resulting in delays and frustration.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Legacy Technology" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-body-color%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

The platform was based on SharePoint 2013 and InfoPath, both of which are no longer supported or well-suited for complex workflow automation.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title="Manual Overhead" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22,%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-body-color%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

Stakeholders relied heavily on spreadsheets, email chains, and recurring data calls to coordinate updates and generate reports.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Fragmented Workflows" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

Safety reviews, approvals, training compliance, and document tracking were handled through disjointed systems and informal processes.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title=" User Fatigue" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

The system’s inefficiencies discouraged adoption, especially among researchers whose time is better spent on core scientific work.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
CASE STUDY

Building a Robust Operations Power App to Replace a Maxed‑Out SharePoint Site

INTRODUCTION
An internal SharePoint 2013 site was originally developed to support the safety review and operations permitting process for over 100 concurrent research and development projects. Over time, the system became increasingly inefficient and difficult to maintain. Researchers and managers were required to navigate a fragmented process involving outdated InfoPath forms, email-based approvals, manually updated spreadsheets, and document libraries that had exceeded practical limits.
As frustrations mounted, users expressed a clear preference for reverting to paper-based workflows rather than engaging with the existing system. Recognizing the operational and compliance risks associated with this legacy platform, the organization engaged M&S to design and implement a more robust, scalable solution.
The Challenge
The existing system presented multiple technical and functional constraints. 
Each time an experiment was modified users were required to re-initiate the entire permitting process. This compounded administrative burden across hundreds of projects, resulting in delays and frustration.

Legacy Technology

The platform was based on SharePoint 2013 and InfoPath, both of which are no longer supported or well-suited for complex workflow automation.

Manual Overhead

Stakeholders relied heavily on spreadsheets, email chains, and recurring data calls to coordinate updates and generate reports.

Fragmented Workflows

Safety reviews, approvals, training compliance, and document tracking were handled through disjointed systems and informal processes.

User Fatigue

The system’s inefficiencies discouraged adoption, especially among researchers whose time is better spent on core scientific work.
The Solution
We led a complete overhaul of the operations permitting process, beginning with in-depth interviews across user groups to identify pain points and map out the existing workflow. This discovery phase resulted in a clear, actionable process model and a prioritized feature set, developed in close collaboration with the business owner.
The team then designed and built a modern Power App, replacing the legacy SharePoint system. The solution included digitized forms, a searchable document library, integrated training compliance tracking, and automated reporting. Historical data and documents were fully migrated, ensuring continuity. Delivered in under a year, the new system streamlined operations and reduced costs, proving that modernization doesn’t have to come with enterprise-scale complexity or price.
the results
The new application is fully deployed and delivering clear results. Researchers and managers who once avoided the old system now actively use the new platform, thanks to its improved speed, usability, and streamlined workflows. Designed for long-term scalability, the app is already expanding to support additional permitting processes. Most notably, it was delivered quickly and cost-effectively. We demonstrated how thoughtful design and targeted technology can transform a broken process into a sustainable, high-impact solution.

The Challenge

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

One enterprise client experienced the same challenge when facing a new implementation of Salesforce that replaced a highly-customized, highly-integrated, mature CRM supporting sales, marketing, support teams of over 700 users, and a total user community of  over 1,000.

There were teams in place supporting many aspects of the marketing, sales, IT, service, support, and billing functions. While their previous CRM took many years of projects,  customizations, executive churn, and development to reach its current state, they only had a few months to make a complete transformation to Salesforce.

Working with a blended team of internal client side and M&S proper talent, we developed a plan to implement Salesforce, AppExchange managed packages, and web services, to seamlessly connect with existing applications.  

We developed a complete strategy that consisted not only of the hard work associated with standing up the new platform, but also team training, new team structure and roles,  implementation change plan, development and release planning, and integration gap analysis and planning. We used an Agile approach to requirements gathering, development, communication, release and support. It was a tough challenge, but we were up to owning the success of the client and implementation!

M&S’s partnership, leadership, and commitment helped navigate the waters to a successful enterprise implementation of Salesforce.com, along with a few third party managed packages and several deeply connected integrations. M&S was there through the planning, analyzing, designing, development and support stages, providing key insight, direction, development, and strategy to the client. M&S worked with the client to support the existing applications through a business as usual (BAU) communication and development strategy, all while moving the various teams toward the new platform direction.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" module_alignment="left" min_height="208px" custom_margin="-19px||||false|false" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

“M&S was there  through the planning,  analyzing, designing,  development and  support stages,  

providing key  insight, direction,  development, and  strategy to the client."

The Conclusion

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The biggest success of this project was the level of automation and standardization achieved. OCI is now fully managed as code, enabling a smooth, reliable, and scalable infrastructure with minimal manual intervention.

This level of automation has transformed operations, reducing cloud management time from hours or days to minutes.

Additionally, OCI’s security and networking framework is now fully standardized, making it easier to troubleshoot, secure, and scale infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and OCI. Lessons learned from this project are now being applied across multiple cloud environments, extending the benefits of this transformation.

Lessons learned from this project are now being applied across multiple cloud environments, extending the benefits of this transformation.

INTRODUCTION

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{}"]

A leader in eye care, this company provides custom contact lenses that gently reshape the cornea while the patient sleeps. This technology allows children to correct their vision without surgery and is particularly effective for nearsightedness.

To meet high demand from eye care professionals worldwide, their system must support both manual and bulk entry for thousands of orders daily.

The Challenge

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

Having parted ways with their previous IT team, the company sought a partner capable of delivering high-level solutions tailored to their challenges.

Order processing was at the top of the list. Their clients, eye care professionals, needed a reliable way to place orders and receive the custom-made lenses their patients required. Each contact lens is made to specific measurements, meaning their system had to handle unique data for each patient and perform complex calculations accurately.

When their Salesforce based order processing system made errors or even crashed, client satisfaction was at risk, especially during busy seasons. Even when the system was running properly, it wasn’t fully optimized for customer service. Team members had to navigate between different sections to assist clients, creating confusion and inefficiencies.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/Vision-case-study-graphic-Large.jpeg" title_text="Vision case study graphic Large" align="center" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" width="74%" max_width="100%" border_radii="on|20px|20px|20px|20px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

Work We Did

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

We leveraged our Salesforce expertise and deep knowledge of order processing to optimize the system, ensuring a more dependable, error free experience. By correcting calculation issues, we greatly reduced the technical roadblocks that were disrupting order accuracy.

We also refined the system’s workflow. In addition to gathering direct feedback from the company’s team, we sat in on their order intake calls, listened to the flow and format they typically followed, and redesigned the system to simplify the process.

    [/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

    The methods

    [/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{}"]

    Our contributions extended beyond technical skills. Our expert project managers also employed agile methodologies (including the Scrum framework) and tools like Atlassian Jira to ensure continuous progress via a collaborative feedback loop:

    • Creating a solution blueprint
    • Refining it with client feedback
    • Developing and implementing the solution
    • Conducting live demos for the team
    • Allowing them to test the solution in their real process
    • Collecting feedback for further enhancements
    [/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22background_color%22%93,%22gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

    The solution

    [/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

    The optimized Salesforce environment now delivers a reliable foundation for accurate order processing, guided by the redesigned workflow and agile enhancements described above.

    [/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

    the results

    [/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

    Today, the company’s order processing system is faster, more accurate, and better optimized for both their team members and clients.

    We continue to maintain and upgrade their order processing capabilities in Salesforce. As they grow, we take the unique order processing systems that each new group brings to the table and integrate those capabilities into their Salesforce environment.

    With a partnership now spanning multiple years, we regularly enhance their system and receive positive feedback for our innovative solutions that make their operations more efficient and streamlined.

    [/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

The Commonwealth of Massachusetts Department of Industrial Accidents (DIA) oversees the state’s workers’ compensation system. Their role is to ensure that injured workers, employers, insurers, attorneys, and health care providers all have the resources they need to comply with relevant laws and regulations. When the physical data center housing their information was slated for demolition, they faced an immovable deadline and turned to M&S Consulting for help.

CASE STUDY

An Urgent Rescue: Delivering a Last Minute Cloud Migration for a Critical Government Agency

INTRODUCTION
The Commonwealth of Massachusetts Department of Industrial Accidents (DIA) oversees the state’s workers’ compensation system. Their role is to ensure that injured workers, employers, insurers, attorneys, and health care providers all have the resources they need to comply with relevant laws and regulations. When the physical data center housing their information was slated for demolition, they faced an immovable deadline and turned to M&S Consulting for help.
The Challenge
The DIA had less than six months to migrate from a physical data center to the cloud. A previous vendor had spent eighteen months on the effort without tangible progress, leaving the agency in a precarious position. Failure to complete the migration before demolition would have put critical data and services at risk.
Work We Did
We stepped in and coordinated closely with the agency’s application engineers and prime contractors to craft a rapid migration plan. Although the DIA relied on Oracle software, Oracle Cloud was not yet a viable option for their stringent security and compliance needs, so we architected a secure Oracle workload migration into AWS. Key steps included:
agsdix-smt1-access-time
Detailed migration planning and timeline alignment with demolition schedules
agsdix-fas fa-hands-helping
Continuous collaboration with client stakeholders to validate requirements
agsdix-smt1-cloud
Leveraging AWS services to optimize performance, storage, and networking for Oracle workloads
agsdix-smt2-lock
Upgrading the Oracle environment during migration to maximize future scalability and security
Solutions

Seamless Migration of Mission-Critical Applications

M&S embedded seasoned OCI engineers, delivered hands‑on workshops, and co‑authored a structured deployment playbook so the university’s team could operate confidently on the new platform.

Strengthened Security with AWS Best Practices

We redesigned networking, security, and firewall policies so OCI meshed with their existing AWS patterns while taking advantage of Oracle‑specific performance and licensing benefits.

Delivered Ahead of Schedule Despite Unforeseen Crisis

Terraform pipelines tied to GitHub Actions now turn every infrastructure change into a version‑controlled, automatically validated pull request, eliminating manual console work and accelerating releases to minutes.
The results
With their workloads running in AWS, the DIA now enjoys

Lower real estate costs and elimination of on premises maintenance

Modern cloud capabilities that improve resiliency and scalability
 

An upgraded customer management system that streamlines claims processing

When a leading media‑ad sales company learned its legacy traffic system would retire the built‑in billing module, the stakes were high. Without a replacement, revenue would stall and advertisers would keep receiving up to thirteen separate, multi‑hundred‑page invoices for a single national campaign. CASE STUDY

From Invoice Chaos to Clarity: SAP BRIM Transformation for a National Media Ad Sales Giant

INTRODUCTION
When a leading media‑ad sales company learned its legacy traffic system would retire the built‑in billing module, the stakes were high. Without a replacement, revenue would stall and advertisers would keep receiving up to thirteen separate, multi‑hundred‑page invoices for a single national campaign. M&S Consulting stepped in to modernize billing, unify data, and deliver results fast.
The Challenge
Swap out the Accounts Receivable component before vendor support ended.
Replace fragmented regional invoicing with one clear, consolidated statement.
Cleanse usage data spanning thirteen regions, product lines, and delivery options.
Launch the first regional rollout in less than twelve months.
Work We Did
M&S Consulting worked in close collaboration with client teams and partners to extend cloud operations into OCI while ensuring a highly automated and infrastructure-driven approach. Our key contributions included:

Requirements and Impact Analysis

M&S embedded seasoned OCI engineers, delivered hands‑on workshops, and co‑authored a structured deployment playbook so the university’s team could operate confidently on the new platform.

Solution Architecture

Selected SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) for rating and invoicing.
Integrated SAP Convergent Mediation by DigitalRoute to collect and cleanse non‑SAP traffic records.
Designed a native handoff to SAP S/4HANA for finance and reporting.

Agile Implementation

Formed a cross‑functional squad of SAP, telecom, and media SMEs, running two‑week sprints in Jira for visibility and rapid feedback.

Data Accuracy and Reconciliation

Built validations so Convergent Mediation output matched traffic totals to the penny, ensuring trust in every invoice.

Change Management and Rollout

Staggered go‑lives by region; launched the first wave in ten months—on time, on budget, and without billing interruption.
The Solutions
SAP BRIM now rates and invoices thousands of daily ad‑spot transactions.
Convergent Mediation harmonizes data across thirteen regions and multiple product lines.
A single, concise invoice replaces stacks of regional statements, boosting customer satisfaction.
Flexible architecture supports future streaming and digital‑product business models.
the results

Revenue Continuity

Billing never lapsed despite the legacy module sunset.

Customer Satisfaction

Advertisers receive one clear invoice, reducing disputes and payment delays.

Scalable Platform

New offers launch quickly without reworking core billing.
Conclusion
Phase two will extend BRIM to additional product lines and introduce self‑service billing portals. If your organization needs modern, usage‑based billing, M&S Consulting can guide the journey from chaos to clarity.

CASE STUDY

From Nine Silos to One System: Rebuilding a Mission Critical Financial Platform

INTRODUCTION
When our team joined this engagement in late 2021, a mission critical financial system was running on nine separate islands of aging infrastructure. Each site had its own Oracle 12c database and its own Oracle Forms stack. No clustering. No shared resources. Downtime and compliance gaps were rising fast.
The Challenge
Consolidate nine standalone environments into a resilient, modern platform.
Keep day to day billing and accounting operations online throughout the transition.
Meet new security patching and version compliance mandates.
Work We Did

Agile Leadership

Adopted sprint planning and Jira tracking to manage backlog and technical road map.
Stepped into architecture lead responsibilities as project evolved, demonstrating M&S “lead with action” ethos.

Ongoing Modernization

Integrated a new enterprise timekeeping feed via biweekly file ingest and validation.
Leading metadata standardization to align with governmentwide financial reporting mandates.

Lift and Shift with Tech Refresh

Migrated nine Oracle 12c instances into a single two node Oracle 19c RAC cluster with pluggable databases for each site.
Consolidated nine Forms and Reports deployments into one shared stack while preserving site specific UI.

Zero Disruption Execution

Orchestrated cutovers during maintenance windows; users experienced no unplanned downtime.
The Solutions
Single Oracle RAC cluster delivers redundancy, scalability, and simplified patch management
Unified application layer reduces maintenance overhead and eliminates version drift
Automated time entry integration ensures data accuracy across sites
Metadata standardization positions system for future analytics and compliance needs
the results

Stability Restored

Uptime improved and support tickets fell as clustered architecture absorbed hardware failures.

Security Up to Date

Regular patching is now feasible across one platform instead of nine.

Lean Team, Big Win

A core team of three delivered the entire migration and continues to drive enhancements.
Conclusion
Modernizing legacy systems does not require massive teams or prolonged outages. With the right expertise and agile mindset, you can lift, shift, and enhance in parallel. If your mission critical platform is stuck in siloed infrastructure, M&S Consulting can help you move fast without dropping the ball.

  • Customer service representatives lacked a unified view of customer activity and service history.

  • The business needed a platform capable of supporting billions of call records with high performance and reliability.

  • Integration with outsourced call centers and IVR systems was essential to ensure consistent customer experiences.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
CASE STUDY

Building a High-Performance CRM & Customer Service Platform for a Telecom Leader

INTRODUCTION
A growing telecommunications company needed a powerful CRM and customer service solution that could handle millions of interactions, integrate seamlessly with existing infrastructure, and deliver real-time insights to both agents and customers. Their existing custom solutions were outdated and not scalable for their rapid growth.
The Challenge
The client relied on homegrown systems that were difficult to maintain and integrate.
Customer service representatives lacked a unified view of customer activity and service history.
The business needed a platform capable of supporting billions of call records with high performance and reliability.
Integration with outsourced call centers and IVR systems was essential to ensure consistent customer experiences.
Work We Did

Advanced Data Integration

We built APIs to feed real-time telecommunication metrics and customer history into the CRM, enabling agents to access detailed insights with a single query.

IVR and Call Center Integration

The platform was integrated with the client’s outsourced call center (also servicing DirecTV at the time), ensuring a seamless flow of information and a superior agent experience.

Scalability and Speed

The platform was engineered to manage over a billion call records, with new data added daily. Search and filtering were optimized for instant results.

CRM and Customer Service Platform

A high-performance system was created to provide a comprehensive view of billing, service tickets, and customer interactions. Key performance indicators were surfaced directly to customer service teams.
The Solutions
A custom CRM that consolidates customer service, billing, and interaction history.
Real-time data visibility for customer care agents, including call history and billing trends.
Integration with IVR systems and outsourced call centers for consistent service.
High scalability and performance, supporting millions of new records each day.
the results

Superior Agent Experience

Customer service reps now have instant access to comprehensive customer data, improving resolution times and satisfaction.

Industry Recognition

The platform was praised for outperforming other high-cost solutions, with outsourced call centers preferring it over major competitors’ systems.

Acquisition and Growth

The success of the system led to the client’s acquisition by Earthlink, where our platform became the flagship customer service product across multiple acquired entities.
Conclusion
By building a robust, scalable platform, M&S Consulting helped the client revolutionize customer service operations and unify data for improved decision-making. Future enhancements will focus on expanding analytics and self-service features.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
CASE STUDY

From Frustration to Full Transformation: A Multi‑Year Salesforce Success Story

INTRODUCTION
A national manufacturing and services organization was struggling through a greenfield Salesforce implementation with multiple components—Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Field Service, and Certinia. The original vendor relationship had soured, leading to stalled progress, user frustration, and growing distrust.
The Challenge
The project was bogged down by misalignment between vendor and stakeholders.
Users and executives resisted changes due to poor communication and lack of confidence.
A wide range of disconnected processes and legacy systems needed to be replaced or integrated.
The implementation required rethinking end‑to‑end operations, from initial customer engagement to final billing.
Work We Did
M&S Consulting was brought in to stabilize the situation. At first, our role was to mediate between the client and their existing vendor, but over time our experts replaced the vendor team entirely.

Assessment and Trust Building

We engaged directly with stakeholders to rebuild confidence in the implementation, listening to user feedback and uncovering pain points.

Process Reengineering

We redesigned business processes from prospecting to contract closeout, automating key workflows and eliminating manual inefficiencies.

Integration and Modernization

We integrated multiple legacy systems into Salesforce, ensuring data consistency and seamless user experiences.

Full Salesforce Ecosystem Implementation

Our team delivered a holistic platform using Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Field Service, and Certinia to unify operations.
The Solutions
A unified Salesforce platform supporting sales, service, field operations, and billing.
Streamlined end‑to‑end processes with automation and improved reporting.
Enhanced stakeholder alignment and user adoption through transparent communication and training.
the results

Operational Transformation

The organization moved from nine separate systems to a single, integrated Salesforce platform.

Stakeholder Confidence

Users embraced the new system after seeing measurable improvements in efficiency and accuracy.

Market Growth

The success of the platform and processes contributed to a private equity acquisition, validating the business value of the transformation.
Conclusion
This multi‑year engagement showcases how M&S Consulting combines technical expertise with change management to drive real transformation. The client is now leveraging Salesforce innovation to scale operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

INTRODUCTION

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" custom_padding="||0px|||" global_colors_info="{}"]

The ERP Common Services (CS) program aimed to create a core operating environment for the U.S. Air Force. This environment, consisting of standardized hardware, databases, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software, would allow multiple Air Force ERP systems to build on a shared foundation rather than duplicating infrastructure for each solution.

The Challenge

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

Traditional Waterfall project management was not suited to the dynamic needs of this program. Hardware acquisition timelines were unpredictable, and the priorities of various mission partners evolved frequently. The challenge was to establish a flexible, scalable approach that would deliver value incrementally while keeping all stakeholders engaged.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

Work We Did

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" custom_padding="||0px|||" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

M&S Consulting introduced the Scrum framework to manage the program. By adopting Agile, we created a process where teams could build, learn, and adapt quickly.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row column_structure="1_2,1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Agile Framework and Backlog Management" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_align="left" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

We implemented Scrum practices, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and regular retrospectives, ensuring that the most critical requirements were prioritized and addressed first.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title="Agile Coaching and Process Optimization" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_align="left" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

We guided teams through the transition from traditional project management to Agile, improving communication, transparency, and responsiveness.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="1_2" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Atlassian Suite Integration" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_align="left" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

We stood up an internal implementation of the Atlassian suite—Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Desk (JSD, now Jira Service Management)—to provide a seamless Agile project management environment.

  • Jira Software was used for sprint tracking, velocity measurement, and burn-down charts.
  • Confluence served as a knowledge hub where teams documented processes and linked artifacts to Jira tickets.
  • Jira Service Desk provided a portal for mission partners to log support and change requests, with a knowledge base for self-service SOPs.

 

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The Solutions

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{}"]
  • Established a shared ERP technology stack to streamline system development.

     

  • Leveraged Jira boards to visualize work and track progress across multiple teams.

     

  • Created a self-service support portal integrated with JSD for partner requests and O&M activities.

     

  • Transitioned repetitive-task teams from Scrum to Kanban for better workflow alignment.
[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

the results

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_blurb title="Improved Communication" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

Stakeholders gained visibility into in-flight work and upcoming priorities.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title="Enhanced Planning" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

Teams improved estimation accuracy and delivery cadence using Agile metrics.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title="Adaptable Framework" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

Teams with recurring tasks successfully migrated to Kanban boards, reducing overhead and increasing efficiency.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

Conclusion

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" custom_padding="||0px|||" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The ERP CS program now operates with an Agile mindset, delivering continuous improvements while meeting the evolving needs of its mission partners. The combination of Scrum, Kanban, and Atlassian tools has built a foundation for scalable, transparent, and effective ERP development.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
CASE STUDY

Agile ERP Implementation: Transforming Air Force Common Services

INTRODUCTION
The ERP Common Services (CS) program aimed to create a core operating environment for the U.S. Air Force. This environment, consisting of standardized hardware, databases, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software, would allow multiple Air Force ERP systems to build on a shared foundation rather than duplicating infrastructure for each solution.
The Challenge
Traditional Waterfall project management was not suited to the dynamic needs of this program. Hardware acquisition timelines were unpredictable, and the priorities of various mission partners evolved frequently. The challenge was to establish a flexible, scalable approach that would deliver value incrementally while keeping all stakeholders engaged.
Work We Did
M&S Consulting introduced the Scrum framework to manage the program. By adopting Agile, we created a process where teams could build, learn, and adapt quickly.

Agile Framework and Backlog Management

We implemented Scrum practices, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and regular retrospectives, ensuring that the most critical requirements were prioritized and addressed first.

Agile Coaching and Process Optimization

We guided teams through the transition from traditional project management to Agile, improving communication, transparency, and responsiveness.

Atlassian Suite Integration

We stood up an internal implementation of the Atlassian suite—Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Desk (JSD, now Jira Service Management)—to provide a seamless Agile project management environment.

Jira Software was used for sprint tracking, velocity measurement, and burn-down charts.
Confluence served as a knowledge hub where teams documented processes and linked artifacts to Jira tickets.
Jira Service Desk provided a portal for mission partners to log support and change requests, with a knowledge base for self-service SOPs.

 

The Solutions
Established a shared ERP technology stack to streamline system development.
 

Leveraged Jira boards to visualize work and track progress across multiple teams.
 

Created a self-service support portal integrated with JSD for partner requests and O&M activities.
 

Transitioned repetitive-task teams from Scrum to Kanban for better workflow alignment.

the results

Improved Communication

Stakeholders gained visibility into in-flight work and upcoming priorities.

Enhanced Planning

Teams improved estimation accuracy and delivery cadence using Agile metrics.

Adaptable Framework

Teams with recurring tasks successfully migrated to Kanban boards, reducing overhead and increasing efficiency.
Conclusion
The ERP CS program now operates with an Agile mindset, delivering continuous improvements while meeting the evolving needs of its mission partners. The combination of Scrum, Kanban, and Atlassian tools has built a foundation for scalable, transparent, and effective ERP development.

INTRODUCTION

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" custom_padding="||0px|||" global_colors_info="{}"]

When a large enterprise made the decision to migrate to Salesforce, they faced a daunting challenge—replacing a highly customized, deeply integrated CRM system that had evolved over years of development. Their sales, marketing, IT, service, and billing teams—over 700 core users and more than 1,000 in the broader community—needed a seamless transition, and they had only a few months to make it happen.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/crm-to-salesforce-graphic-Large.jpeg" title_text="crm to salesforce graphic Large" align="center" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" width="79%" border_radii="on|20px|20px|20px|20px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The Challenge

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The previous CRM had been built and refined through years of projects, executive changes, and custom integrations. While powerful, it had become too rigid and slow for the company’s needs. The Salesforce migration required replacing this mature CRM with a new system that could support all core business functions, integrate with existing applications, and be adopted by hundreds of users—all within an aggressive timeline.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-e6a399bf-d602-4e3d-90b4-45e0e8f3e41c%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

Work We Did

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" custom_padding="||0px|||" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

M&S Consulting partnered with the client to guide them through every stage of this transformation. Rather than simply focusing on the technical implementation, we took a holistic approach that combined strategy, process optimization, and user readiness.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_blurb title="Agile Development and System Alignment" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_align="left" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

We started by creating a detailed roadmap that aligned Salesforce, AppExchange managed packages, and web services with the client’s existing systems. Working closely with internal stakeholders, our team ran collaborative workshops to gather requirements and define priorities. Throughout development, we used an Agile approach to iterate quickly, test new features, and adjust based on user feedback.

[/et_pb_blurb][et_pb_blurb title="Driving Organizational Change and Seamless Integration" image_icon_width="50px" icon_alignment="left" content_max_width="100%" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" header_level="h3" header_font="|600|||||||" header_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" header_font_size="25px" body_text_align="left" body_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" border_width_bottom_image="4px" border_color_bottom_image="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22icon_color%22,%22border_color_bottom_image%22,%22header_text_color%22%93,%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22body_text_color%22%93}"]

We also led organizational change efforts. Training sessions, new team structures, and clear communication plans were all part of our strategy to ensure that the transition to Salesforce wasn’t just smooth, but also embraced by end users. Meanwhile, we conducted deep integration and gap analyses to make sure Salesforce would work seamlessly with the client’s existing platforms.

[/et_pb_blurb][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-3f55128b-3769-41d1-98bd-d2b4c8495188%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The impact

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{}"]

The enterprise rollout of Salesforce was a success. The platform went live fully integrated with key third-party applications and managed packages, immediately streamlining processes across sales, marketing, and support. Within months, over 1,000 users were confidently working in the new system. Efficiency improved, reporting became clearer, and the business gained a modern CRM foundation capable of scaling with future growth.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

conclusion

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" custom_padding="||0px|||" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

Migrating to Salesforce was more than a technical upgrade—it was a transformation in how the client operated. M&S Consulting continues to provide strategic guidance, ongoing enhancements, and support to ensure the platform continues to evolve with the company’s needs.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
CASE STUDY

From Legacy CRM to Salesforce Success: Accelerating Enterprise Transformation

INTRODUCTION
When a large enterprise made the decision to migrate to Salesforce, they faced a daunting challenge—replacing a highly customized, deeply integrated CRM system that had evolved over years of development. Their sales, marketing, IT, service, and billing teams—over 700 core users and more than 1,000 in the broader community—needed a seamless transition, and they had only a few months to make it happen.
The Challenge
The previous CRM had been built and refined through years of projects, executive changes, and custom integrations. While powerful, it had become too rigid and slow for the company’s needs. The Salesforce migration required replacing this mature CRM with a new system that could support all core business functions, integrate with existing applications, and be adopted by hundreds of users—all within an aggressive timeline.
Work We Did
M&S Consulting partnered with the client to guide them through every stage of this transformation. Rather than simply focusing on the technical implementation, we took a holistic approach that combined strategy, process optimization, and user readiness.

Agile Development and System Alignment

We started by creating a detailed roadmap that aligned Salesforce, AppExchange managed packages, and web services with the client’s existing systems. Working closely with internal stakeholders, our team ran collaborative workshops to gather requirements and define priorities. Throughout development, we used an Agile approach to iterate quickly, test new features, and adjust based on user feedback.

Driving Organizational Change and Seamless Integration

We also led organizational change efforts. Training sessions, new team structures, and clear communication plans were all part of our strategy to ensure that the transition to Salesforce wasn’t just smooth, but also embraced by end users. Meanwhile, we conducted deep integration and gap analyses to make sure Salesforce would work seamlessly with the client’s existing platforms.
The impact
The enterprise rollout of Salesforce was a success. The platform went live fully integrated with key third-party applications and managed packages, immediately streamlining processes across sales, marketing, and support. Within months, over 1,000 users were confidently working in the new system. Efficiency improved, reporting became clearer, and the business gained a modern CRM foundation capable of scaling with future growth.
conclusion
Migrating to Salesforce was more than a technical upgrade—it was a transformation in how the client operated. M&S Consulting continues to provide strategic guidance, ongoing enhancements, and support to ensure the platform continues to evolve with the company’s needs.

INTRODUCTION

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{}"]

Expanding access to high-speed internet is essential for economic growth, education, and opportunity. A nationwide broadband initiative set out to close the digital divide through large-scale public grants, but success depended on a platform that could manage complex program rules, high application volume, and continuous change.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][et_pb_row _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="4_4" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_image src="https://www.mandsconsulting.com/wp-content/uploads/Broadband-Initiative-Large.jpeg" title_text="Broadband Initiative Large" align="center" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" width="79%" border_radii="on|20px|20px|20px|20px" global_colors_info="{}"][/et_pb_image][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The Challenge

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]
  • Build a grants management system that reviews, scores, and approves hundreds of applications per program.

  • Balance unique requirements across multiple broadband and digital equity initiatives.

  • Keep delivery moving in a multi vendor environment with more than forty specialists on the project team.

wp:postmeta.wp:meta_value:
CASE STUDY

Connecting Communities: Nationwide Grants Management on Salesforce

INTRODUCTION
Expanding access to high-speed internet is essential for economic growth, education, and opportunity. A nationwide broadband initiative set out to close the digital divide through large-scale public grants, but success depended on a platform that could manage complex program rules, high application volume, and continuous change.
The Challenge
Build a grants management system that reviews, scores, and approves hundreds of applications per program.
Balance unique requirements across multiple broadband and digital equity initiatives.
Keep delivery moving in a multi vendor environment with more than forty specialists on the project team.
Work We Did
M&S Consulting joined as the only external contractor beyond the prime consulting group, providing senior business analysis and hands on Salesforce configuration.

Iterative Development Lifecycle

Guided user stories through Dev, QA, UAT, and Prod with GitHub traceability and automated test scripts.

Dual Role Deliver

Combined BA duties with Salesforce development, creating page layouts, flows, and validation rules directly in the org to speed feedback.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Ran mockups, demos, and working sessions to translate policy requirements into intuitive portal features.

Scalable Architecture

Helped design data models and permission sets that flex for new grant programs without rework.
The Solutions

Customized Salesforce Grants Management to receive 234 broadband infrastructure applications and more than 700 digital equity submissions

Built reusable scoring components so reviewers can evaluate applications consistently across programs

Implemented dashboards and reports for real time oversight and compliance tracking

Established agile ceremonies and Jira boards, improving visibility and decision making for forty plus team members

the results

Streamlined Processing

Applications move smoothly through review and approval, reducing turnaround time.

Enhanced Transparency

Stakeholders track status and funding outcomes in dashboards rather than spreadsheets.

Continuous Improvement

The platform evolves every sprint, ready to support additional grant waves.
Conclusion
Grants management is a living process that grows with program goals and public needs. By pairing technical depth with a service-first mindset, M&S Consulting is helping deliver a connected future for communities nationwide. Work continues on new features and additional grant tracks.

INTRODUCTION

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{}"]

One mid-sized company found itself at that exact crossroads. After years of growth, their aging systems—once dependable—had become bottlenecks, slowing down operations and making it harder to scale effectively.

Realizing it was time to act, they chose to invest in a modernization effort. M&S Consulting was brought in to help guide the transition, not by replacing systems ourselves, but by leading the project with structure, clarity, and a focus on long-term success.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section][et_pb_section fb_built="1" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" background_color="gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-da9599ce-ead5-4724-8b4c-8591836aec28%22:%91%22background_color%22%93}"][et_pb_row column_structure="2_5,3_5" use_custom_gutter="on" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" max_width="1000px" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_column type="2_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="|800||on|||||" text_text_color="gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79" text_font_size="28px" text_letter_spacing="2px" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-ed7c6ec9-aca8-4608-a2b3-bec948137a79%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The Challenge

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][et_pb_column type="3_5" _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" global_colors_info="{}"][et_pb_text _builder_version="4.27.4" _module_preset="default" text_font="||||||||" text_text_color="gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a" text_font_size="20px" text_line_height="1.5em" global_colors_info="{%22gcid-620d7b35-2617-43ff-948e-acc35c98792a%22:%91%22text_text_color%22%93}"]

The organization had been using the same ERP system for years. At one time, it had fit their needs perfectly. But over time, the cracks began to show. Manual processes became burdensome. Data entry errors created costly delays. Month-end closings dragged on longer than necessary.

Sticking with the old system wasn’t just inefficient—it was holding them back from reaching their full potential.
